## Commentary on the Jataka Parijata

If the three planets—the one aspecting the Ascendant <note>Lagna</note>, the Lord of the Ascendant <note>Lagnesha</note>, and the planet situated in the Ascendant—are lords of the 6th, 8th, or 12th houses <note>the 'Dusthanas' or difficult houses</note>, or are in an enemy's house, in debilitation, or otherwise weak, then those planets do not give their full results during their major periods <note>Dasha</note>.

If there are many planets aspecting or residing in the Ascendant, then only the strongest among them should be considered for results. This is according to the author of the *Suka Jataka*. || 28 ||

---

### If the Ascendant is in a watery sign and joined by auspicious planets, they speak of a stoutness of body.
### If the Lord of the Ascendant is in a watery planet's sign, is full of strength, and joined by benefics, they say the body will be well-nourished. || 29 ||

**In the Ascendant:** In a **watery sign** <note>original: "Jalarksha"; refers to Cancer, Scorpio, Pisces, and the latter half of Capricorn</note> (see Ch. 1, Verse 17), if that Ascendant is joined by **auspicious planets** such as Mercury, Jupiter, or Venus, the **body** of the person born will have **stoutness** or fullness. This is what the teachers say. Furthermore, if the **Lord of the Ascendant** is in a **watery planet's sign**, is **full of strength** (possessing the previously mentioned strengths), and is **joined by benefics**, they say the person's body will be well-nourished. || 29 ||

If the Ascendant is a watery sign and joined by benefics, the person's body will be stout. If the Lord of the Ascendant is strong, placed in a watery sign, and joined by benefics, that person's body will be robust. || 29 ||

---

### If the Lord of the Ascendant is in the house of destruction in a dry sign, the body suffers great distress and hardship.
### If the lord of the sign occupied by the lord of the Ascendant's Navamsha is a dry planet, they say the body is withered. || 30 ||

**Lord of the Ascendant:** If the Lord of the Ascendant has **gone to destruction** (meaning the 8th house) and is in a **dry sign** (any of Aries, Sagittarius, Libra, or Leo), then the **body** will suffer great distress and be **afflicted** by disease. **The lord of the sign occupied by the lord of the Navamsha of the Ascendant:** This refers to the planet that rules the sign where the ruler of the Ascendant's rising Navamsha <note>a 1/9th divisional chart</note> is placed. If that planet is a **dry planet** (situated in a waterless terrestrial sign), then the person's **body is withered**, meaning it is little more than skin and bones.

There is another reading: "The lord of the sign occupied by the lord of the Navamsha where the Lord of the Ascendant is placed." In that case, it should be interpreted as the ruler of the sign where the Lord of the Ascendant's Navamsha-lord resides.

**Notes**—**Dry planet:** A planet situated in a dry sign. Dry signs are the waterless terrestrial signs: Aries, Sagittarius, Libra, and Leo (see Ch. 1, Verse 15). || 30 ||

If the Lord of the Ascendant is in a dry sign in the 8th house, the body will be full of suffering. If the Navamsha lord of the Ascendant's position is a dry planet, the body is said to be withered. || 30 ||

In such a case, the **person born will fear enemies**, having a mind filled with suspicion. If **Ketu** or the **Lord of Serpents** (Rahu) is in the Ascendant, and the **Lord of the Ascendant** is **ill-placed** (in the 6th, 8th, or 12th houses), then during the **major period** of the Lord of the Ascendant and the **sub-period of the 6th lord**, one should predict **infirmity** (ill health) in the person's limbs. Furthermore, if the **Lord of Enemies** (the 6th lord) is in the Ascendant and is **joined by the Serpent-bannered one** (Rahu or Ketu), then **body ulcers** or skin diseases will occur on the bodies of men.

If the Lord of the Ascendant is hemmed in by two enemy planets, the person will fear enemies. If Ketu or Rahu is in the Ascendant and the Lord of the Ascendant is in a bad house, then during its major period, when the sub-period of the 6th house lord...

# Chapter 19: Results of the First and Second Houses
<page-num>351</page-num>

If the sub-period <note>Antardasha: a minor planetary period in Vedic astrology</note> is active, one should predict infirmity in the limbs (body) of the native. If the lord of the 6th house (the house of enemies and disease) is in the Ascendant and joined with Rahu or Ketu <note>The North and South Nodes of the Moon</note>, one should predict ulcers or sores on the person's body. || 31 ||

->**If the Lord of the Ascendant is devoid of strength, even if placed in a quadrant or a trine, the native will possess a sickly body.**<-
->**If the lord of the sign occupied by the Ascendant Lord is placed in a bad house, the native will have a weak constitution. || 32 ||**<-

**Commentary:** This verse is straightforward in its meaning. || 32 ||
If the Lord of the Ascendant, lacking strength, is situated in a quadrant <note>Kendra: houses 1, 4, 7, 10</note> or a trine <note>Trikona: houses 1, 5, 9</note>, the body will be somewhat diseased. If the lord of the sign in which the Ascendant Lord is placed is situated in a "bad house" <note>Dusthana: houses 6, 8, or 12</note>, the native will have a weak body. || 32 ||

->**If the Lord of the Body (Ascendant Lord) is joined with a malefic and placed in the 12th, 6th, or 8th house, physical happiness is destroyed.**<-
->**If the Lord of the Body is in a bad house joined with the Lord of the 6th, or is in the Ascendant itself, the native is sickly. || 33 ||**<-

**Commentary:** "Joined with a malefic" means the Lord of the Ascendant is with a cruel planet. If it goes to the 12th, 6th, or 8th, it destroys physical comfort. If the Lord of the Ascendant is "with the essence" <note>original: "sa-ranshe" interpreted here as joined with the 6th lord</note>, meaning joined with the Lord of the 6th house, and is in a bad house (6, 8, 12) or even in the Ascendant, the person born will be sickly. || 33 ||

If the Lord of the Ascendant is joined with a malefic planet and is in the 12th, 6th, or 8th house, there will be a loss of physical well-being. If the Lord of the Ascendant is with the Lord of the 6th in a bad house or in the Ascendant, the native will be ill. || 33 ||

->**If a malefic is in the Ascendant and the Ascendant Lord is weak, the native is sickly.**<-
->**If the Ascendant Lord is weak, the native is irritable; if in a quadrant or trine, they are free from disease. || 34 ||**<-

**Commentary:** The meaning is clear. || 34 ||
If there is a malefic planet in the Ascendant and the Ascendant Lord is powerless, the native will be sickly. If the Ascendant Lord is weak, the native will be prone to anger. However, if that weak Ascendant Lord is placed in a quadrant or trine, the native will be free from disease. || 34 ||

->**If the lord of the sign where the Lord of the Body resides is in the house of destruction, the native is weak.**<-
->**If the lords of the signs occupied by various House Lords are in bad houses, those houses become weak. || 35 ||**<-

**Commentary:** The "Lord of the Body" is the Ascendant Lord. If the lord of the sign where he is placed goes to the "house of destruction" (the 8th house from the Ascendant), the native will be weak or lacking in strength. Similarly, whatever sign a House Lord occupies, if the ruler of that sign is in a bad house (6, 8, 12), that original house becomes weak. || 35 ||

If the lord of the sign occupied by the Ascendant Lord is in the 8th house, the native will be weak. For any house, if the lord of the sign it occupies is in a bad house, that specific house becomes weak. || 35 ||

->**From the union of the Serpent and the Enemy comes an enlarged scrotum; or from the union of the Serpent and Saturn.**<-
->**With Mars in the Ascendant, one should predict ulcers or heaviness in the navel and ankles. || 36 ||**<-

**Commentary:** "Serpent and Enemy" refers to the conjunction of Rahu and Mars. "Serpent and Saturn" refers to the conjunction of Rahu and Saturn. Such a native will have "large seeds" <note>original: "brihad-beeja," referring to scrotal enlargement or hydrocele</note>. If Mars is in the Ascendant, one should predict "heaviness from ulcers in the navel and ankles," meaning a swelling or growth in the navel region or ankles due to injury. || 36 ||

In the conjunction of Rahu and Mars, or Rahu and Saturn, scrotal enlargement occurs. If Mars is in the Ascendant, there is chronic swelling in the navel and diseases of the scrotum. || 36 ||

# With Commentary on the Jataka Parijata

<page-num>352</page-num>

**The Lord of the Ascendant:** If the Lord of the Ascendant is in the **twelfth house (the house of loss)**, and is joined by the lord of the sixth house from the Sun—**the Sun** being where it is, joined by the lord of the enemies (**the sixth lord**) from that position—the person born will be **endowed with a wife, afflicted by various diseases, of a slender body, and possessed of a reddish-fair complexion.** If the Lord of the Ascendant is joined by the lord of the house of enemies (the sixth lord) from the birth ascendant, the person born will be **dark-complexioned.** Furthermore, if the Lord of the Ascendant is joined by Rahu <note>The North Node of the Moon, associated with deception and sudden events</note>, the person **certainly encounters fear from poison or from bondage (deception) || 37 ||**

If the Lord of the Ascendant is in the twelfth house and is joined by the lord of the sixth house from the Sun, the subject will have a wife, many diseases, a thin body, and a fair complexion with a reddish tint. If the Lord of the Ascendant is joined by the lord of the house of enemies from the Ascendant, the subject will be dark-skinned. If the Lord of the Ascendant is joined by Rahu, he will surely have fear of poison through cheating || 37 ||

**If a benefic planet is in the Ascendant and is aspected by a benefic, there is happiness from childhood; this is not so if there is a malefic association.**
**If there is a great multitude of malefic associations in the Ascendant, the teachers say the person will be miserable from childhood until death || 38 ||**

In the Ascendant: If the Ascendant is in a **benefic sign** and is **aspected by a benefic—meaning seen by one or more auspicious planets—the subject attains happiness right from childhood.** If in that Ascendant there is a **malefic association—meaning the joining of a natural malefic—that happiness does not occur.** Furthermore, if there is a **multitude of malefic associations—the joining of many cruel planets—in the Ascendant, the teachers say the person will be miserable from childhood until the time of death.** By this, the result is that for auspicious fruits, the Ascendant must necessarily be a benefic sign and be joined or aspected by benefic planets || 38 ||

If a benefic planet is in the Ascendant and there is also the aspect of a benefic planet upon it, the subject will be happy from childhood. If there is the association or aspect of a malefic planet, he will be unhappy. If there is the association of many malefic planets in the Ascendant, he will remain miserable from childhood until death; so say the teachers || 38 ||

**When Venus is in the Devaloka division, the Lord of the Ascendant is in the Gopura division,**
**And the Ascendant is aspected by benefic planets, one shall obtain happiness in the middle and end of life || 39 ||**

**Devaloka division:** If Venus is placed anywhere in the <term>Devaloka-amsha</term> <note>A specific high-quality strength division in the Vimsopaka system</note>, and the Lord of the Ascendant is situated anywhere in the <term>Gopura-amsha</term> <note>A division indicating the planet resides in four auspicious vargas</note>, and the Ascendant is aspected by benefic planets—Mercury, Jupiter, or Venus—the person born shall obtain happiness in the **middle** and **final** stages of life.

Notes—For the definitions of Devaloka and Gopura divisions, see Chapter 1, verses 45-46 || 39 ||

If Venus is in Devaloka-amsha, the Lord of the Ascendant is in Gopura-amsha, and there is the aspect of a benefic planet on the Ascendant, there will be happiness in the middle and final stages of life || 39 ||

**If a benefic is in the Ascendant, a malefic in the second house, and the angles are joined by malefics,**
**While the Lord of the Ascendant is in an excellent division, there is misery at first and happiness thereafter || 40 ||**

**If the Lord of the Ascendant is in a benefic sign, aspected by a benefic planet,**
**Or has reached the Gopura division, there is happiness after the sixteenth year || 41 ||**

**If the lord of the sign occupied by the Lord of the Ascendant is in an angle, a trine, or its exaltation,**
**Or in the eleventh house with strength, there is happiness after the thirtieth year || 42 ||**

Regarding the three verses starting "In the Ascendant," "The Lord of the Ascendant," and "The lord of the sign occupied," the meaning is simple enough and requires no further elaboration.

If a benefic is in the Ascendant, a malefic is in the second, the angles <note>Houses 1, 4, 7, and 10</note> are joined by malefics, and the Lord of the Ascendant is in an <term>Uttam-amsha</term> <note>An excellent division</note>, there will be misery in the first stage of life and happiness thereafter || 40 ||

# Chapter 11: Results of the First and Second Houses
<page-num>353</page-num>

If the <term>Lord of the Ascendant</term><note>Lagnesha: The planet ruling the rising sign.</note> is in a favorable sign, is aspected by a benefic planet, or is placed in a <term>Gopuransha</term><note>A specific strength in the Varga system where a planet occupies its own or a friendly sign in four specific divisional charts.</note>, the person will find happiness after 16 years of age. || 41 ||

If the lord of the <term>Navamsha</term><note>The 1/9th divisional chart, used to determine the hidden strength of planets.</note> occupied by the Lord of the Ascendant is placed in a <term>Kendra</term><note>The 1st, 4th, 7th, or 10th houses.</note> or a <term>Trikona</term><note>The 1st, 5th, or 9th houses.</note>, or is in its sign of exaltation, or is strong and placed in the house of gains (11th), the person will be happy after 30 years of age. || 42 ||

->When the Ascendant is aspected by the Sun and other planets, the results are told in order:<-
->A servant of the king, a destroyer of the father <note>original: "pitrughno"; the commentary clarifies this as inheriting or using paternal wealth</note>, a trader of water-goods, and very wealthy. || 43 ||<-
->Religious, having a large phallus, endowed with knowledge, craftsmanship, and fame.<-
->Respected by kings, observant of vows, attached to courtesans, wealthy, and happy. || 44 ||<-
->If the Ascendant is aspected by Saturn, one has an old wife, is dirty, and wicked.<-
->If the Ascendant is not aspected by any planet, one should judge by the sign and the planet residing there. || 45 ||<-

Regarding the Ascendant: When the Ascendant is aspected by the Sun and other planets, the results are described according to the sequence of the verses. For example, if the **Sun** aspects the Ascendant, the person becomes a servant of the king and a "destroyer of the father" (meaning a minister to the king and one who possesses paternal wealth). If the **Moon** aspects the Ascendant, they deal in water-goods (selling fish, etc.) and become very wealthy. If **Mars** aspects the Ascendant, they are religious and have a large phallus. If **Mercury** aspects the Ascendant, they are endowed with knowledge, craftsmanship, and fame. If **Jupiter** aspects the Ascendant, they are respected by kings and observant of religious vows. If **Venus** aspects the Ascendant, they are attached to courtesans, wealthy, and happy. If **Saturn** (Manda) aspects the Ascendant, the person has an old wife, a dirty body, and is a wicked soul. Now, if the Ascendant is not aspected by any planet, one should declare the results based on the planet residing in the Ascendant sign. If there are no planets in the Ascendant either, the results should be told based on the aspects on the sign where the Moon is placed. || 43-45 ||

<note>The following section repeats the above Sanskrit commentary in Hindi for the reader's benefit, which is translated here into English.</note>
If the Sun and other planets aspect the Ascendant, their results are told according to the lines of the verse. If the Sun aspects, one serves the king and is wealthy through paternal money. If the Moon aspects, one is wealthy through trade of aquatic creatures or water-related business. If Mars aspects, one is a righteous soul and has a large lingam. If Mercury aspects, one is a scholar, skilled in crafts, and famous. If Jupiter aspects, one is worshiped by the king and follows vows. If Venus aspects, one is attracted to courtesans, happy, and wealthy. If Saturn aspects the Ascendant, one has an elderly wife, is unclean, and is a rogue. If no one aspects the Ascendant, the results are told according to the planet situated in the Ascendant. || 43-45 ||

->If the Lord of the Ascendant aspects the Ascendant, one is a king, or dear to the king, wealthy, and happy.<-
->If aspected by benefics, all is auspicious; if aspected by malefics, it is inauspicious. || 46 ||<-
->One is happy if the Ascendant is aspected by two or more; if aspected by all, one becomes a king.<-
->Three benefics in the Ascendant make a king; three malefics make one miserable. || 47 ||<-

Regarding the Ascendant: If the person is born with the Lord of the Ascendant looking at the Ascendant, they become a king or a favorite of the king, wealthy, and happy. If the Ascendant is aspected by benefic planets, all results related to the Ascendant are good. If aspected by malefics, all results should be declared as inauspicious.

If the Ascendant is aspected by two or more planets, the person is happy. (Here, if aspected by two or more *benefic* planets, the result is even better). If the Ascendant is aspected by all planets, the person becomes a king. Furthermore, if three benefics (Mercury, Jupiter, and Venus) are in the Ascendant, the person becomes a king. Similarly, if three malefics (Mars, Saturn, and the Sun) are in the Ascendant, the person becomes miserable. || 46-47 ||

If the Lord of the Ascendant aspects the Ascendant, one becomes a king, or a favorite of the king, wealthy, and happy.

> If the Lord of the Ascendant is exceedingly powerful, occupies a quadrant, is not aspected by malefic planets, and is aspected by benefic planets, he destroys death and bestows a very long life, along with many virtues and earned wealth. || 48 ||

**Commentary:** Regarding the "Lord of the Ascendant": If the Lord of the Ascendant <note>original: "Lagnadhipa"</note> is exceedingly powerful—endowed with all the previously mentioned strengths—and is situated in a quadrant <note>original: "Kendra"; the 1st, 4th, 7th, or 10th houses</note>, is not seen by malefic planets, but is aspected by benefic planets <note>original: "Shubha-khaga"</note> such as Mercury, Jupiter, Venus, or the full Moon, then he destroys <note>uproots</note> death—meaning the death indicated by childhood afflictions <note>original: "Balarishta"</note>—and grants a very long life. Not only does he grant long life, but he also bestows it along with wealth and prosperity <note>original: "Lakshmi"</note> earned through many virtues such as charity, prayer, and sacred rituals. || 48 ||

## Now, the Results of the Second House.
->First, the consideration of Wealth.<-

> Wealth, eyes, the face, knowledge, speech, family, and food: the wise astrologers know these to be the matters arising from the Second House, in that order. || 49 ||

Now, wishing to explain the results of the Second House, the author states the matters to be considered from the Second House in this verse. Wealth <note>money</note>, eyes, face, knowledge, speech <note>words</note>, family, and food <note>sustenance</note> are the things arising from the Second House; that is, they must be contemplated from the Second House. This is what the astrologers know. || 49 ||

Astrologers have said that wealth, eyes, face, knowledge, speech, family, and food should be considered from the second position. || 49 ||

> If the houses of wealth, gains, and the ascendant are joined by their respective lords, the person becomes very wealthy. Likewise, if the lords of wealth and gains are in the house of gains, or in their own, friendly, or exaltation signs. Similarly, if the lords of gains and wealth are in the ascendant and are mutual friends. If the lord of the ascendant is joined with the lords of wealth and gains in the ascendant, the person possesses great riches. || 50 ||

Now the results of the Second House begin. If the houses of wealth, gains, and the ascendant—meaning the 2nd, 11th, and 1st houses—are joined by their respective lords at the time of birth, the person born becomes "exceedingly wealthy" <note>original: "Vittadhika"</note>. If the lords of wealth and gains <note>the 2nd and 11th lords</note> are situated in the house of gains <note>the 11th house</note>, and are in their own signs, a friend's house, or their sign of exaltation <note>the term "etc." here includes their specific divisional charts like Drekkana and Navamsha</note>, then likewise, the person becomes exceedingly wealthy. Similarly, if the lords of gains and wealth are in the ascendant and are mutual friends to each other, then also the person becomes exceedingly wealthy. Furthermore, if the Lord of the Ascendant is joined with the lords of the 2nd and 11th houses and is placed in the Ascendant <note>meaning a conjunction of the 1st, 2nd, and 11th lords in the 1st house</note>, the person born possesses great riches. Here, four yogas <note>astrological combinations</note> are described. || 50 ||

If the second, first, and eleventh houses are joined by their respective lords, the subject will be very wealthy. If the lord of wealth and the lord of gains are in a friend's place or an exalted place within the house of gains, then...

## From the Annotated Jataka Parijata

If the <term>Lord of Wealth</term><note>Dhanesha: the planet ruling the 2nd house of finances.</note> is in the <term>Ascendant</term><note>Lagna: the 1st house, representing the self.</note> along with the Lord of the 4th house (the house of happiness/mother), the person will inherit wealth from their mother. Similarly, the person will acquire wealth from whichever house lord the Lord of Wealth is positioned with in the Ascendant. || 55 ||

If the Lord of the Ascendant is in the 2nd house and the Lord of Wealth is in the Ascendant, wealth is obtained without effort. People receive wealth through whichever house the Lord of the Ascendant and the Lord of Wealth occupy. For example, if they are in the 3rd house, wealth comes from a brother; if in the 4th, from the mother, and so on. || 56 ||

->The Moon in the house of family, aspected by Venus, makes one a giver.<-
->When Mercury is there, touched by benefics, that person is always known to be wealthy. || 57 ||<-

**The Moon etc.:** If the Moon is situated in the "house of family" (the 2nd house) and is "aspected" (viewed) by Venus, the person born becomes a "giver"—one who gives wealth to others. Here, the word "and" implies that the <term>significator</term><note>Karaka: the planet naturally representing a theme; for wealth, this is usually Jupiter or Venus.</note> should also be aspected by Venus. Furthermore, if "Mercury" is in the 2nd house and is "touched by benefics"—meaning aspected by either Jupiter or Venus, or both—it should be known that the person will always be wealthy. This means they will remain rich throughout their life.

If the Moon is in the 2nd house and is aspected by Venus, and the significator of wealth is also aspected by Venus, one becomes wealthy. If Mercury is in the 2nd house and is aspected by benefics, one remains wealthy forever. || 57 ||

**The Lord of Wealth etc.:** The "Lord of Wealth" (the 2nd lord), at the time of birth, stays in "whichever" house; during the <term>major period</term><note>Dasha: a planetary period in a person's life.</note> of that Lord of Wealth, there is "special growth" in the direction associated with that house. He also creates "gain of money" in that specific direction. Now, if this Lord of Wealth is in "retrograde motion," then "success in all matters" should be predicted for the person in "all directions."

# Chapter 11: Results of the First and Second Houses
<page-num>327</page-num>

If the Lord of Wealth (2nd house) is in the House of Gains (11th house), and the Lord of Gains is in the House of Wealth or in the House of Gains itself, or if both are in Quadrants (1st, 4th, 7th, or 10th houses), the person will be wealthy and famous. || 59 ||

If the Lord of Wealth is in the 12th or 6th house, and the Lord of Expenditure (12th house) is in the House of Wealth, or if the Lord of Gains is in the 6th, 8th, or 12th house, then in all three situations, one should predict the destruction of the person's wealth. || 60 ||

If Jupiter is in the 12th house, the Lord of Wealth is weak, and no benefic planet aspects the Ascendant (1st house), one should predict the destruction of the person's wealth. || 61 ||

If the Lord of the Ascendant is in the House of Wealth, the Lord of Wealth is in the House of Gains, or the Lord of Gains is in the Ascendant, the person will obtain wealth such as buried treasures. || 62 ||

If the Lords of the 1st, 11th, 2nd, and 9th houses are in their highest state of exaltation or in their respective <term>Vaisheshikansha</term> <note>A specific divisional strength in Vedic astrology where a planet gains auspicious points</note>, the person will be a multi-millionaire. || 63 ||

If the Lord of Wealth is in its sign of debilitation, is combust (too close to the Sun), and is in a malefic <term>Shashtyansha</term> <note>The 60th divisional chart, used for fine-tuning predictions</note>, the person will be burdened by debt. || 64 ||

->### Now, the Examination of the Eyes.<-

> If Venus, the Moon, and the Lord of the 2nd house are together in one place, the person is night-blind. If the Sun, Venus, and the Lord of the Ascendant are invisible, the person has mediocre vision. || 65 ||

Now the examination of the eyes is explained: <term>Shukrendu-yayanadhishaih</term> <note>original: "शुकेन्दुयनाधीशैः"</note> = Venus, Moon, and the Lord of the 2nd house; being in one place, wherever that may be, the person born is <term>Nishandhah</term> <note>original: "निशान्धकः"</note> = night-blind (meaning the person born in this yoga is unable to see at night). Now, <term>Surya-shukra-vilagneshaih</term>: if these three planets are invisible = situated in invisible houses (the portion of the houses from the degree of the Ascendant to the 7th house; planets in these specific segments are considered "invisible" or hidden), the person born has <term>Madhya-lochana</term> = ordinary or mediocre eyesight. Thus, in the text *Jataka Alankara*, the definition of night-blindness and mediocre vision is given:

> "If the Lord of the Eyes (2nd house) is joined with Venus and the Moon, and is aspected by malefics without the aspect of benefics, one is night-blind. If Venus and the Sun are joined with the Lord of the Ascendant in the 4th or 8th house, one has mediocre vision." || 65 ||

If Venus, the Moon, and the Lord of Wealth are all together, one is <term>Nishandha</term> (cannot see at night). If the Sun, Venus, and the Lord of the Ascendant are set (combust/invisible), one has mediocre vision. || 65 ||

> If the Lords of the 1st, 2nd, 7th, 9th, and 5th houses have gone to the 6th, 12th, or 8th houses, and if Venus is connected to the Ascendant, the person born suffers from a total lack of eyes. || 66 ||

Now the yoga for the absence of eyes is explained: If the Lords of the 1st, 2nd, 7th, 9th, and 5th houses are, as far as possible, located in the 6th, 8th, or 12th houses, and <term>Sitah</term> = Venus, is <term>Vilagna-sambandhakara</term> = connected to the Ascendant (either placed in the Ascendant or aspecting it), then the person born attains <term>Vilochanabhavam</term> = the absence of eyes, meaning blindness. The meaning is that one born in this yoga becomes blind. || 66 ||

If the Lords of the 1st, 2nd, 7th, 9th, and 5th houses are in the 6th, 12th, or 8th houses, and Venus is related to the Ascendant, the person will be devoid of eyes. || 66 ||

> If Venus is in the Ascendant joined with the Lords of the 5th and 6th houses, there is injury to the eyes due to the wrath of a king. If the Lord of Wealth and Mars are in the Ascendant, those who know say there is a disease of the ears. || 67 ||

If <term>Sitah</term> = Venus, joined with the Lords of the 5th and 6th houses, is situated in the <term>Vilagna</term> = birth Ascendant, then due to <term>Nareshakopat</term> = the anger of a king, <term>Nayana-pramadah</term> = a defect or injury to the eyes occurs. The sense is that a king, out of anger, destroys the eyes of the person born in this yoga. Now, ear disease is explained: If the Lord of the 2nd house and Mars are both in the birth Ascendant, then for that person, the <term>Tajjnah</term> = the experts or scholars, predict <term>Karna-roga</term> = ear disease, such as deafness. || 67 ||

If Venus is in the Ascendant with the Lords of the 5th and 6th houses, there will be a defect in the eyes due to the king's anger. If the Lord of Wealth and Mars are both in the Ascendant, scholars call this <term>Karna-roga</term> (ear disease). || 67 ||

Now begins the examination of the face—*This person is born...* If a benefic (any of Mercury, Jupiter, Venus, or the waxing Moon) is in the house of wealth (the 2nd house) and is in its "exaltation or similar divisions" (occupying its highest sign or other favorable positions), the person born under such a combination has a "good face" (a handsome face). If that house (the 2nd house) is associated with "gentle divisions" (the signs or divisions belonging to benefic planets), this person "surely" (without doubt) attains "perfection of speech" (excellence in their words). This means the words spoken by one born under this combination will come true. If Mars is in the "house of wealth" (the 2nd house) and is aspected by the Sun, the person born attains "facial touch" <note>original: *asyasparsha*</note>, meaning an affliction of the face. Specifically, the person's face may be smeared with clarified butter <note>ghee</note> because the face suffers from disorders of the blood. Furthermore, if Rahu is in the house of wealth and is aspected by a malefic planet, the person born eats "Kodrava" <note>a cheap, coarse millet</note>, meaning they consume poor-quality food. || 70 ||

## On the Consideration of Knowledge and Speech

> If the lord of the house of speech is joined with Jupiter and stays in the house of destruction, muteness occurs.
> A planet does not cause a defect anywhere if it is in its own exaltation or its own sign. || 76 ||
>
> If the lord of speech, Mercury, and Jupiter are in the house of destruction, one is without knowledge.
> If they are in the angles, the trines, or in their own signs, one is endowed with knowledge. || 77 ||

Now the consideration of speech is stated—**Speech:** If the lord of the house of speech <note>the 2nd house lord</note> is joined with Jupiter <note>original: "brihaspati"</note> and has gone to the house of destruction <note>the 8th house</note>, the native's muteness <note>original: "mookata," meaning lack of speech</note> occurs. The meaning is that a person born in this yoga becomes mute. Here an exception is stated—**Everywhere:** in the mentioned and yet-to-be-mentioned bad yogas, if the planet causing that yoga is in its own exaltation or its own sign, it does not cause the defect. Rather, it would actually be the remover of said defect.

If the lord of speech, Mercury, and Jupiter <note>the 2nd lord, Budha, and Guru</note> have gone to the house of destruction <note>the 8th house</note>, the person born is without knowledge <note>original: "nirvidyah," meaning a fool</note>. If the lord of the house of speech (2nd lord) is in the 8th house joined with Jupiter, the native is mute. A planet in its own place or its own sign of exaltation does not cause a defect anywhere. || 76 ||

If the 2nd lord, Mercury, and Jupiter are in the 8th house, the native is devoid of knowledge. If all these are in an angle or a trine, or in their own house, he is endowed with knowledge. || 77 ||

# Chapter 11: Results of the First and Second Houses
### Page 363

If the Lord of the Second House is in the *Gopuransha* <note>A specific division of a sign in Vedic astrology indicating high strength</note> and Venus is in the *Paravatansha* <note>Another auspicious divisional strength</note>, then all those dependent on the native are amazed and grow with great happiness; that is, such a person becomes a protector of his dependents. || 87 ||

> If the lords of the house of wife and the house of family are joined with Venus and a malefic planet, and are placed in "bad houses," they become the destroyers of as many wives as there are planets. If the Lord of Wealth or the Lord of the Seventh House is strong and placed in its exaltation, the native attains only one wife. || 88 ||

**Commentary:** The "lords of the house of wife and family" refers to the Lord of the Seventh and the Lord of the Second. If these two, joined by Venus and a malefic planet <note>original: *papa-graha*</note>, are situated in "bad houses" (the 6th, 8th, or 12th), then they destroy as many wives as there are planets involved. This means: if the Lord of the Seventh or Second is joined with Venus or any one malefic and is poorly placed, it destroys one wife. If joined by two planets, it destroys two wives. Thus, the loss of wives should be predicted based on the number and position of the planets. If the Lord of Wealth (2nd Lord) or the Lord of the Seventh House is strong and in its exaltation <note>original: *tunga*; including its root-trine, own sign, or own divisional charts</note>, then the native attains one wife. In this yoga <note>astrological combination</note>, the man remains devoted to a single wife. || 88 ||

If the Lord of the Seventh and the Lord of the Second are joined with Venus and malefic planets (however many) and are in "bad houses," they destroy that many wives. If the Lord of the Second or Seventh is strong and exalted, there will be only one wife. || 88 ||

->**Now, the Consideration of Vessels and Food.**<-

> If the Lord of the House of Eating is with Venus and the Moon and situated in a Center (1, 4, 7, 10), the native obtains a silver vessel. If joined with Jupiter, the Moon, and Venus, he obtains a golden one. If the Lord of the House of Eating and the Lord of the Body are joined with Saturn, one should predict a vessel of iron. If Mars is in the Second House and aspected by a malefic, the native eats "bad food." || 89 ||

**Commentary:** The "House of Eating" <note>original: *bhukti-sthana*</note> is the Second House. If its lord (the 2nd Lord) is joined with Venus and the Moon and placed in any of the Centers <term>Kendra: the 1st, 4th, 7th, or 10th houses</term>, the native obtains a vessel made of silver. If that same 2nd Lord is in a Center but joined with Jupiter, the Moon, and Venus, he obtains a vessel made of gold. If the 2nd Lord and the Lord of the First House <note>original: *dehapau*, Lord of the Body</note> are joined with Saturn, the native obtains a vessel of iron or similar metals. Regarding the food: if Mars, aspected by a malefic (Saturn, the Sun, or a waning Moon), is placed in the Second House, the native becomes a consumer of "bad food" <note>original: *kadanna*; refers to poor quality, stale, or coarse food</note>. || 89 ||

If the Lord of the 2nd House is with Venus and the Moon in a Center, the native gets a silver vessel. If the 2nd Lord is with Jupiter and Venus, he gets a gold vessel. If the 2nd Lord and 1st Lord are with Saturn, say he gets an iron vessel. If Mars is in the 2nd house and seen by a malefic, the native eats coarse food. || 89 ||

> The native is a "great eater" if the Lord of the House of Eating is with a malefic and falls in the *Davagni*, *Danda*, *Ayudha*, or *Kala* divisions, or is in its sign of debilitation and aspected by a malefic. If joined or aspected by benefics, this fault does not occur. || 90 ||

**Commentary:** If the 2nd Lord is with a malefic and resides in the *Davagni*, *Danda*, *Ayudha*, or *Kala* portions <note>specific 1/60th divisions of a sign known as Shashtyamsas</note>, the native becomes a "great eater" <note>original: *bahvashana*; one with an excessive appetite</note>. If the 2nd Lord is in its debilitation <note>original: *nichansha*</note> and aspected by a malefic, the same result (excessive eating) occurs. However, if in these combinations the 2nd Lord is joined or aspected by benefics <note>original: *shubha-graha*</note>, the fault is cancelled—he will not be an excessive eater. || 90 ||

# Now begins the Chapter on the Results of the Third and Fourth Houses || 12 ||

->Regarding the results of the Third House.<-

> Elder and younger siblings, prowess, courage, the voice of the throat, hearing, fine ornaments and clothes, firmness, virility, strength, and the eating of roots and fruits—I shall speak of all these in order from the Third House. || 1 ||

Now, wishing to explain the results of the Third House, the author first states what matters are to be considered from the Third House. The verse is clear in its meaning and requires no further elaboration. || 1 ||

Now we consider the Third House. From the Third House, we shall discuss in order: elder and younger siblings, prowess, courage, the voice of the throat, hearing, ornaments, clothing, firmness, virility, strength, and the consumption of roots and fruits. || 1 ||

->Now, the consideration of siblings.<-

> The third house is the place of siblings, as are the eleventh, ninth, and seventh. In the periods (*Dashas*) of their respective lords, men obtain siblings. || 2 ||

Now, after defining the places of siblings, the author discusses the consideration of siblings. The Third, Ninth, Eleventh, and Seventh houses from the Ascendant are called the places of siblings. Therefore, during the *Dasha* (planetary period) of the lords of these houses—the 3rd, 7th, 9th, or 11th—the birth of siblings occurs for the native. Among these houses, whichever lord is strongest at the time of birth, it should be understood that siblings will specifically be gained during that planet's period. || 2 ||

The 3rd, 9th, 11th, and 7th are the houses of siblings. In the periods of the lords of those places, men gain siblings. || 2 ||

> Among the lord of the third house, the lord of the sign where the third lord sits, and the planets situated in the third house, the period of the one endowed with the most strength brings an increase in siblings. || 3 ||

Among the Lord of the 3rd House, the lord of the sign occupied by the 3rd Lord, and the planets placed within the 3rd House, the period of the strongest planet among them causes an increase in siblings. || 3 ||

The period of the strongest planet among the Lord of the 3rd house, its dispositor <note>the lord of the sign it sits in</note>, and the planets located in the 3rd house, will be the one that increases the number of brothers/siblings. || 3 ||

# With the Commentary on Jataka Parijata

If the Moon is in the 6th, 8th, or 12th house <note>These are considered 'dusthanas' or difficult houses in Vedic astrology</note> and is joined with the lord of the 3rd house, the person is said to be breastfed by another <note>i.e., a wet nurse</note>. If both the lord of the 4th house and the lord of the 3rd house are in the 4th house, there will be no increase in the number of brothers for the person. || 12 ||

If the lord of the 3rd and the lord of the 4th are joined with Mars, one should give away a brother <note>possibly referring to adoption or separation</note>. If they are joined with other planets, there may be no brother. If Saturn is in the 3rd house, it destroys brothers, but if Rahu <note>the North Node of the Moon</note> is there, it increases the number of brothers. || 13 ||

->**If the lord of the 3rd house is in an invisible sign, or joined with a malefic, or placed in the house of the wife (7th house),**<-
->**there will be no younger brother born after the current younger brother. The same result occurs if it is in a masculine division in a visible sign.**<- || 14 ||

**Commentary:** "Lord of the 3rd house" means the ruler of the third bhava. "Invisible signs" refers to the six signs starting from the specific degree of the Ascendant <note>the houses below the horizon, 2nd through 7th</note>. If the lord is in any of those, or "joined with a malefic" (a natural cruel planet), or "in the house of the wife" (the 7th house), then "after the born younger brother," there will be "no younger brother" (a smaller sibling). This means that if the person already has a younger brother, no further younger brothers will be born, or after one younger brother, no others will follow. Furthermore, if the lord of the 3rd is in a "visible sign" (the six signs from the 7th house back to the Ascendant) but is in a "masculine division" (related to odd-numbered signs like Aries or Gemini), the result is the same: no younger brother will follow the one already born. || 14 ||

If the lord of the 3rd house is in an invisible sign or in the 7th house joined with a malefic, then after one brother is born, no more shall follow. If it is in a visible sign but in a masculine division, the same result applies. || 14 ||

->**If the lord of the house of brothers is in a masculine sign, a younger brother is born.**<-
->**If it is in an even sign joined with or aspected by Venus and the Moon,**<-
->**or if the lord of the 3rd is in a sign of a benefic planet, joined/aspected by benefics, and placed in a center or a trine,**<-
->**the sibling born afterward will be happy for a long time, long-lived, and healthy.**<- || 15 ||

**Commentary:** "Lord of the house of brothers" (3rd lord) being in a "masculine sign" (odd signs like Aries, Gemini, etc.) indicates a younger brother will be born. Alternatively, if the 3rd lord is in an "even sign" (Taurus, Cancer, etc.) and is "joined with" or "aspected by" <term>Bhargava (Venus)</term> and <term>Shashi (the Moon)</term>, a younger brother is born. Furthermore, if the 3rd lord is in a "benefic sign," "aspected or joined by a benefic planet," and placed in a <term>Kendra (1, 4, 7, 10)</term> or a <term>Trikona (1, 5, 9)</term>, then the "sibling born afterward" (the younger brother) will be "happy for a long time" (enjoying happiness throughout life), "long-lived," and "healthy." || 15 ||

If the lord of the 3rd house is in a masculine sign, he will have a brother. If the 3rd lord is in an even sign and is joined with or aspected by Venus and the Moon, a younger brother will be born. If the 3rd lord is in a benefic sign, aspected/joined by benefics, and in a center or trine, the subsequent brother will be long-lived and healthy. || 15 ||

->**If the lord of the house of siblings is in the Ascendant, or if the lord of the Ascendant is with the lord of the 3rd,**<-
->**the mother's subsequent pregnancy will be safe; the same applies if the 3rd lord is in the 3rd house.**<- || 16 ||

**Commentary:** "Lord of the house of siblings" (3rd lord) being "in the Ascendant" (1st house), or the "lord of the 3rd" being "joined with the lord of the Ascendant," means that for this person's "mother," the "subsequent pregnancy" will be "safe" (without obstacles). If the "3rd house" contains its "own lord" (the 3rd lord is in the 3rd house), the result is the same. This yoga <note>astrological combination</note> means the mother of the person will successfully and safely bear more children. || 16 ||

# Chapter 12: Results of the Third and Fourth Houses
### Page 369

If the Lord of the Third House is in the Ascendant <note>The first house or rising sign</note>, or if the Lord of the Third is joined with the Lord of the Ascendant, then the pregnancy following that of the native is safe from harm. If the Lord of the Third is situated in the Third House itself, the same result occurs. || 16 ||

->**Now, the Knowledge of the Number of Siblings.**<-

**The number of elder siblings is determined by the number of planets located in the eleventh and twelfth houses. The experts say that the number of younger siblings is determined by the planets situated in the third and second houses from the Ascendant.** || 17 ||

Now the author explains the number of siblings through the verse beginning with "The number of elder..." From the birth Ascendant, the "houses of gain and loss" refer to the eleventh and twelfth houses. The number of planets situated in those two houses indicates the native's elder siblings <note>original: *agraja-jana*</note> or brothers born previously. This means that however many planets reside in the eleventh and twelfth houses, that is the count of the native's elder siblings. Similarly, experts in the results of the houses say that the number of planets present in the third and second houses from the Ascendant indicates the younger siblings <note>original: *anuja*, those born afterward</note>.

<note>Notes—Here, the number of masculine planets indicates elder or younger brothers, while the number of feminine planets indicates sisters.</note> || 17 ||

One should state the number of elder brothers based on how many planets are in the 11th and 12th houses from the Ascendant. Scholars say the number of younger brothers is determined by the planets situated in the 3rd and 2nd houses from the Ascendant. || 17 ||

**Whenever the planets associated with or aspected by the Lord of the Third House and the Significator of brothers are endowed with great strength, the native certainly obtains a number of younger siblings equal to those strong planets. If the four <note>The four factors: the Significator, the Lord of the Third, the planet aspecting the house, and the planet residing in it</note> are in debilitation, combust, or in enemy signs, they destroy the siblings who are born. If those planets are strong and auspicious, they grant long life to all the younger siblings.** || 18 ||

Whenever the planets aspected by or joined with the Lord of the Third House and the <term>Significator</term> <note>original: *Karaka*, the planet representing a specific life area; for siblings, this is Mars</note> of brothers are powerful and full of strength, the native certainly attains the birth of younger siblings equal to the number of those strong, associated planets. The essence is that however many strong planets are joined with or seen by the Lord of the Third and the Significator, that is the number of siblings. Regarding "the four": the four authorities over the house of brothers are—the Significator, the Lord of the Third, the planet aspecting it, and the planet situated there. If these four are in their signs of debilitation, are combust <note>original: *mudha*, hidden by the sun's light</note>, or are in the houses of enemies, they destroy the siblings who have been born. In this yoga <note>astrological combination</note>, the younger siblings born to the native do not survive. If those four planets are "favorably strong"—meaning in their exaltation, in a friend's house, or otherwise powerful—they grant a long life to all the younger siblings. || 18 ||

The number of younger brothers born is equal to the number of planets that are particularly strong and are aspected by or joined with the Lord of the Third House and the Significator of brothers. If the four factors are in debilitation, combust, or in an enemy's place, they destroy the brothers who are born. If the four planets are in auspicious places and are strong, they make the brothers long-lived. || 18 ||

**When two among the group of planets led by the Lord of the Third House are powerful, they give a mixed result of destruction and non-destruction. If three planets are superior in strength, [they grant siblings]. If the planets are in "bad houses" <note>Houses 6, 8, or 12</note> or are feminine planets, they cause a reduction in the number of siblings. If there is a slight increase in younger siblings, the number corresponds to the Navamsha <note>The ninth divisional chart</note> of the Lord of the Third.** || 19 ||

The group of planets where the Lord of the Third is the chief...

# With the Commentary on Jataka Parijata

Page 370

In the group of four <note>referring to the four indicators of siblings: the lord of the 3rd house, the planet aspecting the 3rd, the planet occupying the 3rd, and Mars as the natural significator</note>, when two planets are powerful (possessing strength), they provide an equal measure of destruction and non-destruction. This means they give as much auspicious as inauspicious results. The implication is that among these four planets, if two are strong and two are weak, they produce an equal balance of good and bad. If three of these four planets are superior in strength, there is a slight destruction of siblings. In that case, the auspicious results are greater and the inauspicious results are very few. Furthermore, if the female planets (<term>Yogakarakas</term> <note>planets that produce prosperity</note>) are situated in "bad houses" (6th, 8th, or 12th), they cause a small increase in younger siblings. This means only a few younger siblings will be born. The number of younger siblings is determined by the <term>Navamsha</term> <note>a 1/9th division of a zodiac sign used for fine detail</note>. The number of younger siblings corresponds to the number of the Navamsha occupied by the lord of the younger siblings (<term>Trityesha</term> <note>the Lord of the 3rd House</note>) in whichever house it is placed. || 19 ||

> If among the four—the Lord of the brother's house, the planet aspecting the brother's house, the planet situated in the brother's house, and the significator of brothers (Mars)—even two are fully powerful, they cause equal loss and gain of brothers. If three are powerful, they destroy a few brothers; if female planets are in bad houses, they increase the number of brothers slightly. the number of younger brothers is equal to the Navamsha of the Lord of the 3rd house. || 19 ||

---

->**In the case of Mars (the Earth-born) in the house of siblings, however much strength exists,**<-
->**excluding enemies and debilitated planets, that is the number of siblings remembered.**<-

<term>Bhumija</term> = Mars; in the house of siblings = the 3rd house. Excluding enemies and debilitated planets = leaving aside its enemy planets and planets in their signs of debilitation, however many = the number of planets that have auspicious points in the <term>Ashtakavarga</term> <note>a system of points used to calculate planetary strength</note>. This is what is being said here: Mars, situated in the 3rd house, provides auspicious results based on the number of planets it receives points from, excluding enemies and debilitated planets. That number = that specific count, siblings = brothers and sisters, are remembered = stated for the person born. || 20 ||

> In the <term>Ashtakavarga</term>, however many planets Mars (in the 3rd) receives auspicious points from—excluding those that are enemies or in their signs of fall—that is the number of brothers. || 20 ||

---

->**Sisters are given when in the signs of female planets; brothers are given when in the signs of male planets.**<-
->**The Lord of siblings and Mars provide happiness from brothers and sisters.**<-

<term>Sodaresha-Kujau</term> = the Lord of the 3rd house and Mars. If they are in the signs of female planets = the female planets are Venus and the Moon; their signs are Taurus, Libra, and Cancer. If they are situated in those, then they are "sister-givers" = they grant sisters. If they are in the signs of male planets = the male planets are the Sun, Mars, and Jupiter; their signs are Leo, Aries, Scorpio, Sagittarius, and Pisces. If situated in those, they cause the birth of brothers. By implication, if one is in a male sign and the other is in a female sign, they provide happiness from both brothers and sisters. || 21 ||

> If the Lord of the 3rd and Mars are in female signs, they give a sister. If both are in male signs, they give a brother. These same two planets provide the joy of brothers and sisters. || 21 ||

---

->**If the house of brothers from the Ascendant is joined by a female Hora or a female planet,**<-
->**the person born gains a sister; otherwise, a brother follows.**<-

From the Ascendant = the rising sign at birth; in the house of brothers = the 3rd house. If joined by a <term>female Hora</term> = the Hora of the Moon <note>a 15-degree division of a sign; the second half of odd signs or the first half of even signs</note> or joined by a female planet (the Moon or Venus), the person born gains a sister. Otherwise, a brother follows. If the house of brothers is joined by a male Hora or a male planet, the person born gains a brother. "After that" means one should predict the gain of a sister or brother for the subsequent births. || 22 ||

> If in the 3rd house the Moon's Hora or a female planet (Moon, Venus) is present, the person... <note>The original text cuts off here.</note>

->The Significator, the Lord of the third house, the planet aspecting it, and the planet situated there;<-

Now, regarding the house of siblings, he mentions four authorities—the Significator, etc. 1. The <term>Karaka</term> <note>Significator; for siblings, this is usually Mars</note>, 2. The <term>Sahajadhisha</term> <note>Lord of the 3rd house</note>, 3. The <term>Taddarshi</term> <note>The planet aspecting the 3rd house</note>, 4. The <term>Tatra Samsthita</term> <note>The planet residing in the 3rd house</note>. Those possessing the previously mentioned good characteristics give auspicious results, while those with bad characteristics give inauspicious results. || 23 ||

The Significator of siblings, the Lord of the third house, the planet aspecting the third house, and the planet situated in the third house—these four planets give auspicious or inauspicious results during their periods and sub-periods. || 23 ||

->The younger siblings are determined by the sum of the degrees of the four planets starting with the Significator;<-
->Degrees of planets in debilitation, enemy houses, or combustion are excluded, while those in exaltation are doubled. || 24 ||<-

Regarding the four planets starting with the Significator (Significator, Lord of the 3rd, the aspecting planet, and the resident planet): the younger siblings are determined by the sum of their longitudes. By totaling their exact positions (signs, degrees, etc.), the number of <term>Navamshas</term> <note>the 1/9th division of a sign, used here to count siblings</note> contained in that sum indicates the number of younger siblings born. However, one must exclude those in debilitation, in an enemy's house, or in combustion <note>too close to the Sun</note>. These should not be added to the total. Conversely, for planets in their sign of exaltation, their degrees are doubled.

Alternatively, one may take the number of <term>Navamshas</term> each of these four planets occupies individually, sum them up, and divide by four; the resulting number of <term>Navamshas</term> indicates the siblings. Here too, exclude debilitated or combust planets and double the exalted ones. In the text <insert>Jataka Ratnakarana</insert>, only three planets are considered: "The Lord of the 3rd, Mars, and the Lord of the 3rd from Mars." As the verse says:

> "The degrees of the Lord of the 3rd house, the degrees of Mars, and the degrees of the Lord of the 3rd from Mars should be added together. The result obtained from the division indicates the siblings in order." || 24

By totaling the <term>Navamshas</term> of the previously mentioned four (Significator, Lord of the 3rd, the one aspecting the 3rd, and the one residing in the 3rd), one can state the number of siblings. Planets that are debilitated, in an enemy's house, or combust should not be included in the sum, and those in their exaltation degrees should be doubled. || 24 ||

->Predict the results for the brother's wife from the seventh sign from the third;<-
->The Lord of the Ascendant, Mars, and the Lord of the third grant the brother's ill-fortune or prosperity. || 25 ||<-

One should predict the auspicious or inauspicious results for the brother's wife from the seventh house from the third <note>the 9th house of the main chart</note>, or simply from the ninth house from the Ascendant. If the ninth house and its Lord are aspected by benefics and are strong, the brother's wife will have good fortune; otherwise, the results are inauspicious. The Lord of the Ascendant, Mars, and the Lord of the third house provide the ill-fortune or prosperity of the brother. If these are strong and aspected by benefics, they bring good to the brother; otherwise, they bring misfortune. || 25 ||

Predict the results for the brother's wife through the seventh sign from the third house. Consider the ill-fortune or prosperity of the brother from the Lord of the Ascendant, Mars, and the Lord of the third house. || 25 ||

If those two (the Lord of the Ascendant and the Lord of the third) are strong and are mutual friends...

When Saturn moves into the constellation <note>Nakshatra</note> identified by the degrees of the Lord of the Ascendant <note>Lagnēsha</note> and the Lord of the Tenth House, the brothers of the person born do not survive. Alternatively, one should predict the same result when Saturn enters the combined degrees of the four factors (the <term>Karaka</term> <note>Significator, usually Mars for siblings</note>, the <term>Sahajadhisha</term> <note>Lord of the 3rd House</note>, the planet aspecting it, and the planet situated there). || 30 ||

Subtract the clear position of the Lord of the 3rd House from the clear position of the Lord of the Ascendant; when Saturn is in the constellation resulting from that remainder, predict the death of the siblings. Subtract the Lord of the 10th and Mars from that same Lord of the Ascendant; if Saturn is in that remaining sign, or if Saturn is at the degrees resulting from the sum of the four—the Lord of the 3rd, the one aspecting the 3rd, the one staying in the 3rd, and the significator of the 3rd—the same result is predicted. || 30 ||

### When Jupiter enters the sign of the Decan <note>Drekkana - a 10-degree subdivision of a sign</note> occupied by the sum of the four factors, they say the destruction of siblings occurs.

Now, the author describes the affliction of brothers based on Jupiter's position. By "the four" (the significator, the Lord of the 3rd, the one aspecting it, and the one situated there), when Jupiter enters the sign of the Decan occupied by the sum of their clear positions, they say the destruction of siblings occurs. One should predict the destruction of the brother of the native when Jupiter enters the sign of the Decan resulting from the sum of those four planets. The major period <note>Dasha</note> of the lord of the constellation <note>Nakshatra</note> obtained from that sum will be a giver of great wealth and happiness to the younger siblings. || 31 ||

**Notes**—Here, the lords of the constellations should be understood in relation to the major periods <note>Mahadasha</note>. The planet whose period is associated with a particular constellation is the lord of that constellation (See Chapter 18, Verse 3). || 31 ||
By adding the four (previously mentioned factors), if Jupiter is in the sign of the resulting Decan, the destruction of brothers is said to occur. The major period of the lord of the constellation of that combined sum is especially happiness-giving for younger brothers. || 31 ||

### Now, the Consideration of the Throat.

**If the Lord of Valor is with the Lord of the sign occupied by Rahu, and Rahu is in the Ascendant,**
**there is fear of snakes. If the Lord of the Third is joined with Mercury, one suffers from throat disease.** || 42 ||

Now the author describes the fear of snakes and throat diseases. If the Lord of the Third is with the Lord of the sign where Rahu <note>the North Node of the Moon</note> is placed, and Rahu is in the Ascendant <note>term: Lagna (the rising sign)</note>. This means the Lord of the Third should be with the Ascendant Lord and Rahu should be in the Ascendant. Alternatively, the Lord of the Third is with the dispositor of Rahu, or Rahu is in the Ascendant. Then the native experiences fear from snakes. If the Lord of the Third is joined with Mercury, the native suffers from **throat disease**; this means a disease occurs in the throat region for one born under this yoga <note>planetary combination</note>. || 42 ||

If the Lord of the Third is joined with the Lord of the sign Rahu occupies, and the Ascendant is joined with Rahu, there is fear of snakes. If the Lord of the Third is joined with Mercury, the native has throat disease. || 42 ||

**A malefic in the Third causes throat disease here, especially if joined with Mandi and others.** || 43 ||
**If Mars and a strong Saturn are in the Third House, there is skin irritation or itching.** || 43 ||
**If the Lord of the Third and Jupiter are in the Ascendant, they indicate fear of cattle,** || 44 ||
**provided they are joined with Rahu or the Lord of the sign Rahu occupies.** || 44 ||
**The Lord of the Third with Mercury causes throat disease.** || 45 ||
**If a malefic in an enemy's or debilitated sign is in the Third, the brother is lost to poison, etc.** || 45 ||
**If Mercury or Jupiter joins or aspects the strong Third House,** || 46 ||
**or if Jupiter or Mercury is in a quadrant from it, one attains a very beautiful voice.** || 46 ||

The meaning of these verses is simple. || 43-46 ||

If a malefic planet is in the third, there is throat disease. If joined with secondary planets like Gulika <note>original: "mandi"</note>, the throat disease is severe. If Mars and Saturn are strong in the third house, there is an itching disease.

If the Lord of the Third and Jupiter are both in the Ascendant joined with Rahu or its dispositor, there is fear of oxen or cows. || 44 ||

The Lord of the Third House with Mercury produces throat disease. If a malefic planet in an enemy's sign or debilitation is in the third house, there is a loss of brothers through poison or similar means. || 45 ||

### On the Consideration of Clothing

> If the lord of the younger brothers <note>The lord of the third house</note> is in the tenth house, or in the seventh house, or in a sign of a benefic planet and joined with one, the person obtains wonderful and divine clothing. If a benefic is in the third house, one receives good clothes.

Now the consideration of clothing is explained: <term>Lord of the younger brothers</term> <note>Anuja-patau</note> means the lord of the third house. <term>In the tenth</term> <note>Mana-stha</note> means situated in the tenth house. Or <term>In the horse</term> <note>Turage</note>; the word "horse" (Turaga) signifies the number seven <note>A common Sanskrit numerical code or 'Sankhya' where horses represent the seven horses of the Sun's chariot</note>, thus it means the seventh house. If the lord is in a sign of a benefic and joined with a benefic, the person born obtains "unprecedented" (wonderful) and "divine" (beautiful) clothing. If a benefic planet is in the "Sahaja" (third) house, one receives good clothes. A person born under this yoga <note>planetary combination</note> becomes eager to savor the nectar of stories from the Puranas, histories, and virtuous paths. || 50 ||

If Mercury is in the third, beautiful clothes are received. If Venus and the lord of the third house are strong, they give many clothes and ornaments. If both are joined with or aspected by Jupiter and Mercury, they cause one to listen to religious stories. || 50 ||

Now, the author discusses the consideration of a person's courage through a pair of verses beginning with **"Endowed with courage."** These two verses are clear in their meaning, so no further commentary is needed. <note>The commentator suggests the Sanskrit verses 51-52 are self-explanatory and proceeds to the Hindi translation.</note> || 51-52 ||

If the Lord of the Third House is in the <term>Navamsha</term> <note>A sub-divisional chart representing one-ninth of a sign, used to assess the hidden strength of planets</note> of a benefic planet, and is placed in a <term>Vaisheshikansha</term> <note>A specific high-quality divisional strength</note> while being aspected by a benefic, the person will be courageous. || 51 ||
If the Lord of the Third House is joined with or aspected by a malefic planet, or is placed in a "bad house" <note>The 6th, 8th, or 12th houses</note>, his courage will be destroyed. If the Lord of the Third House is in a <term>Kendra</term> <note>Angular houses: 1st, 4th, 7th, or 10th</note> or a <term>Trikona</term> <note>Trine houses: 1st, 5th, or 9th</note> and is joined with or aspected by a benefic, he will be courageous. || 52 ||

### On the Consideration of Strength

-> When the Lord of Vitality is joined with the Son of the Earth <note>Mars</note> and placed in a malefic sign, it causes the destruction of vitality. <-
-> If placed in a Kendra or Trikona with Venus and endowed with strength, the person possesses great vitality and manifests the qualities of enjoyment. ॥ 53 ॥ <-

Through this verse, the person's strength is considered. When the "Lord of Vitality" (the Lord of the Third House) is joined with Mars and is in a malefic sign, it becomes the cause for the destruction of vitality. This means the person born under this influence becomes weak.

Furthermore, if the Lord of the Third House is with Venus and is strong, the person has great vitality and manifests the qualities of enjoyment. || 53 ||

If the Lord of the Third House is joined with Mars and sits in the sign of a malefic planet, it destroys strength; but if the strong Lord of the Third is with Venus in a Kendra or Trikona, the person will be very potent and shine with the qualities of pleasure and luxury. || 53 ||

### On the Consideration of Food

-> Excluding Venus and the Maker of Night <note>The Moon</note>, if a benefic is in the House of Siblings <note>The 3rd House</note> from the Ascendant, <-
-> and is in a benefic sign or Navamsha, the person attains the pleasure of good food. ॥ 54 ॥ <-

Now the consideration of food is stated: **"Excluding Venus..."** Excluding Venus and the Moon, if a benefic planet is in the Third House from the Ascendant and is in a benefic sign or Navamsha, the person attains "happy eating" (good food). It is specified "excluding Venus and the Moon" because if the Moon or Venus are in the Third, it does not result in the pleasure of good food. <note>This is a specific technical exception in this tradition of astrology.</note>

If Mercury or Jupiter (the benefics) are in the Third House from the Ascendant (excluding Moon and Venus) and are in a benefic Navamsha, the person will be provided with excellent food. || 54 ||

-> If the Lord of Vitality is in the sign, Navamsha, or <term>Drekkana</term> <note>A one-third division of a sign</note> of Jupiter, or is aspected by the Teacher of the Gods <note>Jupiter</note>, <-
-> or if a strong Mars is in a Kendra or Trikona from that Lord, the person will be fond of bulbs, fruits, roots, and juices. ॥ 55 ॥ <-

If the Lord of Vitality (Lord of the 3rd) is in Jupiter's sign (Sagittarius or Pisces), Navamsha, or Drekkana, and is aspected by Jupiter, or if a strong Mars is in a Kendra or Trikona (1, 4, 7, 10 or 9, 5) from that Third Lord, the person will be fond of eating bulbs, fruits, roots, and juices. || 55 ||

If the Lord of the Third House is in Jupiter's sign, Navamsha, or Drekkana, or if strong Mars is in the Kendra or Trikona of the 3rd House, the person will be a lover of the juice of bulbs, roots, and fruits. || 55 ||

-> Venus placed in the House of Siblings or Enemies <note>3rd or 6th houses</note> brings sorrow, disease, and fear. <-
-> But in those same places, it becomes auspicious if it is ahead of the Maker of Light <note>The Sun</note>. ॥ 56 ॥ <-

Venus, when placed in the 3rd or 6th house, brings sorrow, disease, and fear to the person. In those same houses (3rd or 6th), if it is "ahead of the Sun," it becomes auspicious. This means Venus would be in the 3rd or 6th while the Sun is in the 2nd or 5th respectively. || 56 ||

If Venus is in the 3rd or 6th house, it gives sorrow, disease, and fear. However, if that same Venus is positioned ahead of the Sun, it becomes auspicious. || 56 ||

# With Commentary: Jataka Parijata
## Results of the Second and Fourth Houses

> *If Jupiter and Venus are joined in the house of food <note>the Second House</note>, or if its lord is joined with or aspected by a benefic planet, or if the house is aspected by a powerful benefic, the person becomes a giver of food to others.* || 57 ||
>
> *If a benefic planet is in its sign of exaltation in the house of food and is aspected by another benefic, or if the lord of that house is in a "Vaisheshika" division <note><term>Vaisheshika-amsha</term>: A specific high-quality division in the ten-fold or sixteen-fold varga system indicating great strength</note>, the person will enjoy excellent food and comforts.* || 58 ||

**Commentary:** "In the Bhukti" means in the Second House. If Jupiter and Venus are present there, or if the "Lord of Bhukti" (the ruler of the Second House) is joined with or aspected by a benefic, or if the house is aspected by any powerful benefic planet, the person born will be a provider of food to others.

If a benefic—meaning Mercury, Jupiter, or Venus—is in its exaltation sign and situated in the Second House, and is aspected by a benefic planet, or if the Lord of the Second House has attained a *Vaisheshika* division, then the person is granted the enjoyment of happy meals and comforts. || 57-58 ||

## Now, the Results of the Fourth House

> *The learned say that education, mother, happiness, perfumes, cattle, kinsmen, qualities of the mind, sovereignty, vehicles, land, and houses are all to be understood from the Fourth House.* || 59 ||

Through this verse, the author lists the matters to be considered from the Fourth House. The experts in house-results say that education, mother, happiness, fragrances, cattle, relatives, mental disposition, kingdom/authority, vehicles (conveyances), land, and buildings are produced by the influence of the Fourth House. The investigation of these matters must be conducted through the Fourth House. || 59 ||

### Now, the Consideration of Education

> *If the "House of Consideration" <note>the Fourth House</note> is joined by its own lord, or joined/aspected by benefics, and if the son of the Moon <note>Mercury</note> is powerful, the person born is clever in education and humility. If the lord of that house is in a bad state <note>placed in the 6th, 8th, or 12th houses</note>, joined with or aspected by malefic planets, or situated in a malefic sign, the person becomes devoid of education.* || 60 ||
>
> *If the lord of the house of education, Jupiter, and Mercury are placed in the 6th, 3rd, 12th, or 8th houses, or are in debilitation or enemy signs, they grant a lack of education, intellect, and discrimination. If they are in their exaltation, own signs, trines, or angles, the person is an expert in sacred knowledge, humility, and logic, and is dear to the king of kings.* || 61 ||

**Commentary:** These two verses consider education. In the "House of Consideration" (the Fourth House), if it is joined by the Fourth Lord and aspected by a benefic, or if Mercury (the son of the Moon) is strong there, the person becomes skilled in learning and discipline. If the Fourth Lord is in a "dusthana" (the 6th, 8th, or 12th houses), or joined/aspected by malefics, or in a malefic sign, the person is uneducated or a fool.

The "Lord of the House of Education," Jupiter, and Mercury—if these three are in the 6th, 3rd, 12th, or 8th houses...

# Chapter 12: Results of the Third and Fourth Houses

If the lords of the houses are situated in <term>debilitation</term> <note>the sign where a planet is weakest</note> or in an enemy’s house, the person born will be deficient in education, intellect, and discernment. In this yoga <note>astrological combination</note>, the meaning is that the person lacks wisdom. However, if the significators of education—Jupiter and Mercury—are in their signs of exaltation, their own signs, or placed in the <term>Trines</term> (1st, 5th, 9th houses) or <term>Quadrants</term> (1st, 4th, 7th, 10th houses) from the Ascendant, then the person will be skilled in wealth, education, and humility, and will be a favorite of great kings. **[60-61]**

If the Lord of the Fourth House is joined with or aspected by a benefic planet in the fourth house, and Mercury is strong, the person will be clever and endowed with education and humility. If the Lord of the Fourth is in a "bad house" <note>the 6th, 8th, or 12th houses</note>, joined with a malefic, aspected by a malefic, or in a malefic sign, the person will be devoid of education. **[60]**

If the Lord of the Fourth, Jupiter, and Mercury are placed in the 6th, 3rd, 12th, or 8th houses, they destroy education, intellect, and discernment; the same result occurs if these planets are in debilitation or an enemy's house. If these planets are in their own houses, exaltation, Trines, or Quadrants, the person will be skilled, endowed with wealth, education, and humility, and beloved by the King of Kings. **[61]**

### Analysis of the Mother

> If Venus or the Moon is very strong, aspected by benefics, and placed in auspicious divisions and in a Quadrant, and the House of the Mother is powerful, scholars declare long life for the mother. **[62]**
>
> If the Lord of the Mother’s House is in the 6th or 12th house and lacks strength, and a malefic is in the Ascendant aspected by another malefic, the wise predict the destruction <note>death</note> of the mother. **[63]**
>
> If a waning Moon is in the 8th, 6th, or 12th house joined with a malefic, and the <term>Patala</term> <note>the 4th house, representing the "underworld" or foundation</note> is joined with a malefic, there is no doubt the mother will be lost. **[64]**
>
> If Saturn is in the Mother’s House aspected by a malefic, and the Lord of the 8th House is in an enemy's house or debilitated, one should point to the destruction of the mother. **[65]**
>
> If malefics are in the 3rd and 5th houses, the Lord of the 4th is in an enemy's sign or debilitated, and the Moon is joined with a malefic, one should predict disease for the mother. **[66]**

Now the analysis of the mother is performed through the five verses starting with "If Venus..." If Venus or the Moon is <term>balistha</term> <note>possessing full strength</note>, aspected by benefics, in auspicious divisions, and located in a Quadrant from the Ascendant, and the Fourth House is powerful, the learned declare <term>chirayustvam</term> <note>long life</note> for the mother. The other verses are clear in their meaning. **[62-66]**

If the Lord of the 4th House is with the Lord of the 6th and stays in the 9th house, it makes the father a <term>vita</term> <note>a rogue or a sensualist</note>. If the Lord of the Mother's House is with the Lord of the 9th and stays in a benefic house, it likewise makes the father a rogue. **[67]**

If the Lords of the 6th and 9th are in the House of the Father, they cause the father to be unchaste. If the Mother, Father, Enemy, and Body <note>Lords of the 4th, 9th, 6th, and 1st houses</note> are all in one place, the person is born of another <note>illegitimate</note>. **[68]**
