# Chapter on the Results of the Third and Fourth Houses || 12 ||

If a cruel planet <note>malefic</note> is situated in the center <note>the 1st, 4th, 7th, or 10th houses</note> or specifically in the fourth house <note>the house of the mother</note>, the native becomes one who commits incest with his mother or his teacher's wife. || 69-70 ||

If the Moon or the Sun, aspected by or joined with a malefic planet, is in a center, or if a cruel planet is in the fourth house and a malefic aspects the fourth house, that native will be a mother-violator. || 69 ||

If the Moon or Venus is in a center and aspected by a malefic, or if there are malefic planets in the 4th house from both of them, that native will be a mother-violator or a violator of the teacher's wife. || 70 ||

->If the Moon is in the fourth house with Mars and the lord of the sixth, the mother has relations with another.<-
->The Sun with Rahu <note>the North Node</note> causes the mother to be unchaste.<- || 71 ||
->If the Moon is joined with Rahu or Ketu <note>the South Node</note>, she has union with a low-born man.<-
->Joined with Saturn, with a Shudra; with Mercury, with a Vaishya.<- || 72 ||
->Joined with the Sun, with a Kshatriya; with the two ministers <note>Jupiter or Venus</note>, union with a Brahmin.<-
->In this way, the Moon joined with Mars and the lord of the sixth gives those results.<- || 73 ||

Now he describes the combinations for the mother's unchastity in three verses beginning with "If in the fourth." If the Moon is joined with Mars and the lord of the sixth house and is placed in the fourth house, then the mother engages in sexual intercourse with another man <note>a paramour</note>. If the Sun is joined with Rahu in the fourth house, it causes the mother to be unchaste <note>union with another man</note>. When the Moon is in the fourth house joined with Rahu or Ketu, one should predict the mother's union with a "low" man, meaning a man of a degraded class. If the Moon in that same position <note>the 4th house</note> is joined with Saturn, the union is with a <term>Shudra</term> <note>the laboring class</note>; if joined with Mercury, with a <term>Vaishya</term> <note>the merchant class</note>; if joined with the Sun, with a <term>Kshatriya</term> <note>the warrior/ruling class</note>; and if joined with the "two ministers," meaning Jupiter and Venus, the mother's union is with a <term>Brahmin</term> <note>the priestly class</note>. Thus, the Moon joined with Mars and the lord of the sixth in the fourth house gives that result, meaning it makes her unchaste, as previously stated in verse 71. || 71-73 ||

If Mars, the lord of the sixth, and the Moon are in the fourth house, his mother engages in intercourse with another. If the Sun is with Rahu in the 4th, it also makes the mother unchaste. || 71 ||

If the Moon is in the 4th joined with Rahu or Ketu, she has union with a low-born person. If joined with Saturn, with a Shudra. If joined with Mercury, with a Vaishya. If joined with the Sun, with a Kshatriya, and if joined with Jupiter or Venus, the native's mother engages in intercourse with a Brahmin. Similarly, there is a result for the Moon being joined with Mars and the lord of the sixth. || 71-73 ||

->The Moon in an unfavorable house with the lord of the third makes the child drink the milk of another.<-
->If the lords of the houses that destroy the mother and father are in bad houses, and the lord of the ascendant is strong, the parents die.<- || 74 ||

Now he describes the unfavorable combinations for the parents. If the Moon is joined with the lord of the third house and goes to an unfavorable house <note>the 6th, 8th, or 12th</note>, then the newborn drinks the milk of another <note>a wet nurse</note>. A person born under this combination loses his mother. If the "destroyers of mother and father," meaning the lords of the fourth and ninth houses, are in bad houses, and the lord of the ascendant is strong, the death of the parents <note>mother and father</note> occurs. || 74 ||

If the Moon is in an unfavorable (8th) house with the lord of the third, the native drinks another's milk. If the lord of the 4th and the lord of the 9th are in evil houses and the lord of the ascendant is strong, the mother and father die. || 74 ||

->If the lord of the father's actions is in a bad house and the lord of the ascendant is strong,<-
->He causes harm to the parents or is without the hair-parting ceremony.<- || 75 ||

The "lord of the father's actions" refers to the lord of the 10th house from the father's house (the 9th), which is the 6th house from the ascendant. If that planet is in a bad house <note>6th, 8th, or 12th</note> and the lord of the birth ascendant is strong, the native causes harm to his parents, or he himself may be devoid of the <term>Simantonnayana</term> <note>the "parting of the hair" pregnancy ritual, implying an auspicious or legitimate birth status</note> sacrament. || 75 ||

If the lord of the 10th from the 9th is in a bad house and the lord of the ascendant is strong, he causes harm to the parents or is without the <term>Simanta</term> ritual. || 75 ||

Alternatively, if they are related to the Sun (a friend of the Sun, aspected by the Sun, joined with the Sun, or in the Sun's sign) and are aspected by or joined with either the 4th or 9th lords, they similarly cause death in succession. || 78 ||

# Chapter 12: Results of the Third and Fourth Houses

When Jupiter and Saturn transit through the remainder <note>The mathematical result of subtracting one planetary position from another</note> or its trines (the 5th and 9th positions), the death of the mother occurs. This should be considered as follows: Subtract the Sun's longitude from the Moon's longitude; when Saturn transits the resulting sign and Jupiter transits the resulting degree, one should predict the mother's death. Furthermore, subtract the position of *Yamakantaka* <term>Yamakantaka: A mathematical point or "shadow planet" in Vedic astrology, usually considered auspicious but used here for timing calculations</term> from the longitude of the lord of the 8th house from the Moon. When Saturn transits that resulting sign and the Sun transits that resulting degree, the mother of the native meets her end. || 80 ||

### On the Consideration of Happiness

> If Jupiter is in the *Gopura* <term>Gopura: A specific strength classification where a planet occupies its own or exalted sign in four different divisional charts</term> or similar divisions, or is placed in the House of Happiness (4th House), and other planets are in the 2nd, 11th, or 4th houses, the person will be happy. || 81 ||
> If the 4th house is aspected by or joined with Mercury, or is placed between two benefic planets, or falls in the sign or division of Jupiter, the person is always devoted to virtuous deeds. || 82 ||
> If a strong planet situated in a suspicious sign is in the 4th house, is connected to the Ascendant, and possesses high qualities <note>referring to *Ashtakavarga* points</note>, the person receives constant happiness from people of that planet's caste and gains wealth through the metals associated with that planet. || 83 ||
> If the lord of an inauspicious house from the Ascendant is in the 4th house in its sign of debilitation or an enemy's sign, and is an enemy to the Lord of the Ascendant, they say the happiness of the body and soul is destroyed through its wrath. || 84 ||
> If the planets situated in the 4th, the lords of the 4th, and the significators of the 4th are endowed with strength, they cause great happiness. If they are debilitated, in enemy signs, or combust, they give undesirable results. Happiness comes from benefics, and misery from others. || 85 ||
> If the Lord of Fortune (9th Lord) is in the 4th house with Venus and is exceptionally strong, the person will be a seeker of pleasures for a long time. If the Lord of Fortune is joined by a benefic but placed in the 8th, 6th, or 12th house, the native attains happiness only for a short time. || 86 ||

The author now explains the consideration of happiness through these five verses starting with "If Jupiter is in the *Gopura*..." These verses are considered to have simple meanings and are thus left without extensive commentary. || 81-86 ||

If Jupiter is in the *Gopura* division or in the House of Happiness, and other planets are in the 2nd, 11th, and 4th houses, one is happy. || 81 ||

If Mercury aspects the 4th house, or the 4th house is between two benefics, or in Jupiter's division, one is always engaged in virtuous deeds. || 82 ||

A strong planet in a good sign in the 4th house, connected to the Ascendant and having many auspicious points, brings constant happiness from the classes of people represented by that planet and wealth from that planet's metal. || 83 ||

If the lord of the 8th house from the Ascendant is in the 4th in a debilitated or enemy sign, and is an enemy of the Ascendant lord, the happiness of the body is destroyed. || 84 ||

If the occupants, lords, and significators of the 4th house are strong, there is great happiness. If they are debilitated, in enemy signs, or combust, they are harmful. If these three are auspicious, there is happiness; otherwise, there is unhappiness. || 85 ||

If the 9th lord is in the 4th with Venus and is very strong, one enjoys life for a long time. If the 9th lord is with a benefic but in the 8th, 6th, or 12th, happiness is short-lived. || 86 ||

# Now, the Determination of Happiness and Other Matters

> One should consider happiness from the Fourth House and Jupiter; matters of the mother from the Fourth House and the Moon.
> Fragrances, clothing, vehicles, and ornaments are considered from the Fourth House and Venus. || 87 ||

Now the author explains the details for considering happiness, mother, fragrances, clothing, vehicles, and ornaments: "Happiness," etc. The "House" refers to the Fourth House; "Jupiter" <note>original: "Ijya"</note>—from these two, one considers happiness. From the Fourth House and the Moon, one considers the mother. From the Fourth House and Venus, one considers fragrances, as well as clothing, vehicles, and ornaments. One should predict the good or bad fortune regarding these matters based on the favorable or unfavorable positions of the Fourth House and the respective planets. || 87 ||

<note>The following is a Hindi summary of the Sanskrit verse above</note>
Consider happiness from the 4th House and Jupiter. Consider the mother from the 4th House and the Moon. Consider fragrances, clothing, vehicles, and ornaments from the 4th House and Venus. || 87 ||

# Now, the Consideration of Fragrances

> When the Lord of the Fourth House is in a favorable sign, and is aspected by or conjoined with Venus,
> and is free from the aspect of enemies or planets in debilitation, the person attains the pleasure of fragrances, garlands, and the like. || 88 ||

Now the consideration of fragrances, garlands, etc., is performed. "Lord of the Fourth House"—if he is situated in a "favorable sign" and is "aspected by or conjoined with Venus," and is "free from the aspect of enemies or planets in debilitation" <note>meaning not looked upon by planets in their sign of fall or in an enemy's house</note>, the person born attains the pleasure of fragrant substances, garlands, and so on. || 88 ||

<note>Hindi summary</note>
If the 4th Lord is in a favorable sign, is seen by Venus or joined with Venus, and is free from the sight of enemy or debilitated planets, the native will possess the pleasure of fragrances, garlands, and ornaments. || 88 ||

# Now, the Consideration of Clothing

> With a powerful Moon, one gets beautiful clothes; with the "Snake-Flag" <note>Rahu or Ketu</note>, one gets very old clothes.
> With Jupiter, silk; with Venus, jewel-studded or variegated; and with Saturn, black clothing. || 89 ||

Now the consideration of clothing is performed. "The Moon" <note>original: "Shitakara," the cool-rayed one</note>, if "endowed with strength" according to the previously mentioned strengths, the native obtains "beautiful clothes" or excellent garments. If the Moon is with the "Snake-Flag"—meaning joined with Rahu or Ketu—one obtains very old or worn-out clothes. If the Moon is joined with "Jupiter," one obtains "silk" <term>Kausheyaka: silk cloth derived from cocoons</term>. If the Moon is with "Venus," one obtains "jewel-variegated" clothes, meaning garments made wondrous with gems and the like. If the Moon is with "Saturn," the person born receives "black" clothing. Here, the effects of the Moon joined with the Sun, Mars, or Mercury are not mentioned; in those cases, one should say: with the Sun, torn clothes; with Mars, burnt clothes; and with Mercury, clothes featuring various artistic designs.

Notes—In verse 87, it was said that "clothing, vehicles, and ornaments are from the Fourth House and Venus." However, here the consideration of clothing is made from the Moon, which seems like a contradiction of the initial promise; this should be reflected upon. || 89 ||

<note>Hindi summary</note>
If the Moon is strong at birth, beautiful clothes are obtained. If the Moon is joined with Rahu or Ketu, old clothes are obtained. If joined with Jupiter, silk; if with Venus, jewel-studded; if with Saturn, black clothes are obtained. || 89 ||

Now the consideration of wealth such as animals is performed. If the "Lord of the Fourth House" is situated in the "division" <note>varga</note> of either Venus or the Moon, and is "joined or aspected" by Venus or the Moon, and is free from being in a debilitated or enemy state, or from the sight of "malefic planets"...

### On the Consideration of Kinship

When the Lord of the house of kin is a benefic planet and is aspected by benefic planets, and the significator <note>term: Karaka—the planet that naturally represents a specific area of life</note> is full of strength, the person will be honored by their relatives. || 61 ||

If the Lord of that house is placed in a center <note>term: Kendra—the 1st, 4th, 7th, or 10th houses</note>, a trine <note>term: Kona—the 1st, 5th, or 9th houses</note>, or the house of gains <note>the 11th house</note>, is in a "Vaisheshika" division <note>term: Vaisheshika-amsha—a high-quality planetary strength based on multiple divisional charts</note>, and is free from the association of malefic planets, the person will be a benefactor to their kin. || 62 ||

One will always be a hater of kin if malefic planets occupy the fourth house <note>original: "rasātale"—a poetic term for the 4th house</note>, or if it is joined by debilitated or combust planets and lacks the association of benefic planets. || 63 ||

Now the consideration of kin is made. The meanings of the verses here are straightforward. || 61-63 ||

If the Lord of the Fourth is a benefic, benefics aspect it, and the significator of happiness is full of strength, the person will be respected by relatives. || 61 ||

If the Lord of the Fourth is in a center, trine, or the house of gains, and is in a Vaisheshika division without malefic influence, they will be helpful to their relatives. || 62 ||

If a malefic planet is seated in the 4th house with a debilitated or combust planet, and there is no aspect or association from a benefic planet, he is always an opponent of his friends. <note>Author: Su. Sha.</note>

### On the Consideration of the Mind

If the Lord of the Eighth <note>term: Randhrapesha</note> is with a malefic and a malefic is in the house of happiness (4th), the person is deceitful. If that Lord of the Eighth is in its sign of exaltation, a friend's sign, or its own division, and is aspected by benefics, the person is without deceit. || 64 ||

One has a pure heart and a peaceful mind if the Lord of the Heart <note>the Lord of the 4th house</note> is endowed with strength, or is in a "Gopura" or "Mridu" division <note>specific auspicious subdivisions of a sign</note>. || 65 ||

In these two verses, the qualities of the native's mind are considered. The meanings of the verses are clear. || 64-65 ||

If the Lord of the Eighth is joined with a malefic and a malefic is in the 4th house, one is a hypocrite. If that Lord of the Eighth is in exaltation, a friend's house, or its own varga, and benefics aspect it, one is not a hypocrite. || 64 ||

If the Lord of the Heart (4th Lord) is powerful, or in Gopuransha or Mridunsha, one will have a pure heart and a peaceful mind. || 65 ||

### On the Consideration of Vehicles

When the Lord of Vehicles is strong and the sign representing vehicles is endowed with strength and aspected by a benefic planet, one should predict the gain of vehicles and such. || 66 ||

If the Lord of Vehicles is placed in the house of vehicles (4th) along with Mercury <note>original: "senduje"—with the son of the Moon</note> and aspected by a benefic, or is in the sign or division of a benefic planet, one should predict the gain of vehicles. || 67 ||

If the Moon is related to the Ascendant <note>term: Lagna—the rising sign</note> and joined with the Lord of the Fourth, the great sages say the person will possess horse-carriages. || 68 ||

If the Moon is in the second or fourth house in an auspicious sign and joined with a benefic planet, one obtains horse-carriages. || 69 ||

If the Lord of the Fourth is with the Moon in the Ascendant, and also joined with the Lord of the Ascendant, there is the gain of horses. If the Lord of Vehicles is joined with Venus or the Lord of the Ascendant, there will be "human-vehicles" <note>note: likely referring to palanquins carried by men</note>. || 100 ||

If Venus and the Full Moon are strong and placed in a center or trine, they bestow palanquins and ornaments. _

> **If these four are in auspicious divisions, very strong, and related to the Ascendant,**
> **Mutually occupying or aspecting each other, the native is a ruler of the earth, long-lived, happy,**
> **Splendid, and marked by the four-fold army, vast fortune, and royal insignia. || 108 ||**

From the Lord of the Ascendant: From where the <term>Lord of the Ascendant</term> <note>original: "Lagnesha"</note> is placed, the <term>Lord of the House of Happiness (Fourth)</term> = the <term>Lord of the Fourth</term>, and the planet in that house = <term>the one in the fourth house from the Lord of the Ascendant</term>; likewise, the <term>Lord of Fortune</term> from the Lord of the Ascendant = the <term>Lord of the Ninth</term>, and the <term>one situated in Fortune</term> = the planet in the ninth—if these four planets are in <term>auspicious divisions</term>, <term>very strong</term>, and if they are <term>related to the Ascendant</term>, and are mutually occupying each other's signs or aspecting one another, then the native becomes a <term>Ruler of the Earth</term> = a King, long-lived, happy, splendid, and <term>marked by the four-fold army, vast fortune, and royal insignia</term>. || 108 ||

<insert>
If the planet in the 4th, the Lord of the 4th, the Lord of the 9th, and the planet in the 9th are all strong, in auspicious divisions, connected to the Ascendant, and mutually aspecting or occupying each other's signs, the native shall be a king with a long life, happy, radiant, possessing the four-fold transport (elephants, chariots, cavalry, infantry), immense wealth, and royal symbols. || 108 ||
</insert>

---

> **If three planets are superior in positional strength, there are wonderful jewel-ornaments and vehicles.**
> **When two planets are endowed with power in the Ascendant, happiness arrives during their period. || 109 ||**

If among the <term>four planets</term> mentioned previously (in verse 108), <term>three planets</term> are <term>superior in positional strength</term>, then the native obtains <term>wonderful jewel-ornaments</term> and transport = <term>the happiness of vehicles</term>. Furthermore, when <term>two planets</term> are <term>endowed with power</term> and are placed in the <term>Ascendant</term>, the native attains happiness during <term>the planetary period of those planets</term>. || 109 ||

<insert>
If three of the aforementioned four planets have positional strength, one obtains ornaments of various gems and vehicles. If two planets are powerful and in the Ascendant, happiness is gained during their Dashas (planetary periods). || 109 ||
</insert>

---

> **If even one of the Lords of the Vehicle Sign is strong in the three mentioned places,**
> **And related to the Ascendant or its Lord, that period bestows vehicles. || 110 ||**

If even a single <term>Lord of the Vehicle Sign</term> (<term>Lord of the Fourth</term>) is strong and situated in any of the <term>three mentioned places</term> (the 1st, 4th, or 9th <term>houses</term>), and is related to the <term>Ascendant</term> or the <term>Lord of the Ascendant</term>, then <term>that period</term> <note>original: "Dasha"</note> becomes a <term>bestower of vehicles</term>. It should be said that during that period, the person will <term>gain a vehicle</term>. || 110 ||

# Page 388
## From the Commentary on Jataka Parijata

If even one of the lords of the three aforementioned houses (4th, 9th, or 11th) is strong and related to the Ascendant <note>The 'Lagna' or rising sign</note> or its lord, then its planetary period will bestow vehicles upon the native. || 150 ||

->If the lords of the fourth, ninth, eleventh, and second houses<-
->are related to the Ascendant and possess great strength,<-
->then in their respective periods, one attains kingdom, fortune, wealth, and assets in order.<- || 111 ||

If the lords of the 4th (vehicles/happiness), 9th (fortune), 11th (gains), and 2nd (wealth) are related to the Ascendant and are fully endowed with strength, then in their respective planetary periods <note>Sanskrit: *paka*, referring to the dasha or ripening of karma</note>, one attains a kingdom, fortune, wealth, and assets. In the period of a strong 4th lord related to the Ascendant, one gains a kingdom. In such a period of the 9th lord, fortune. In such a period of the 11th lord, gain of wealth. In such a period of the 2nd lord, one attains assets.

> **Notes**—Here, the "relationship" <note>Sanskrit: *sambandha*</note> is widely accepted as being of four types: 1. Positional relationship (exchange of signs), 2. Aspectual relationship (looking at one another), 3. Friendly relationship, and 4. Relationship by association (occupying the same sign). || 111 ||

If the lords of the 4th, 9th, 11th, and 2nd are related to the Ascendant and possess great strength, then in their periods, one attains a kingdom, the rise of fortune, gain of wealth, and the accomplishment of goals, respectively. || 111 ||

->If those four are endowed with great strength and related to the body (Ascendant),<-
->all these results will be abundant; if weak, they will cause sorrow.<-
->If mixed, the results are mixed; if the significator, the house lord,<-
->and the planet occupying the house are devoid of strength, they cause great distress.<- || 112 ||

"Those four" refers to the lords of the 4th, 9th, 11th, and 2nd; the rest is clear and requires no further explanation. || 112 ||

If the lords of the four previously mentioned houses (4, 9, 11, 2) are very strong and related to the Ascendant, the results associated with those houses will be fully realized. However, if they are weak, they bring sorrow. If they are of mixed strength, they give mixed results. If the significator <term>Karaka: the planet that naturally represents a specific area of life</term>, the house lord, and the planet sitting in that house are all powerless, they cause extreme suffering. || 112 ||

->If the lord of vehicles is in an enemy's sign, in debilitation, or in a bad house,<-
->and is aspected by the lord of the ninth,<-
->one obtains a very poor vehicle or possesses a fleeting vehicle.<- || 113 ||
->If benefic planets in their signs of exaltation are in the 9th, 10th, or 1st houses,<-
->and are aspected by the lord of the Ascendant,<-
->one may meet with suffering at the end of a journey by vehicle.<- || 114 ||

If the lord of vehicles (the 4th lord) is in an enemy's house, in its sign of debilitation <note>The sign where a planet is weakest</note>, or in a "dusthana" <note>the 6th, 8th, or 12th houses, associated with difficulties</note>, and is aspected by the 9th lord, the person will obtain a "bad vehicle" or a "fickle vehicle" (one that does not last). This can also imply obtaining a wicked or unstable army. As stated in the *Sarvartha Chintamani*:

> "If the lord of vehicles is in a bad house or combust, even if aspected by the lord of fortune or the lord of gains, one gets a wicked army or a flickering army."

If benefic planets in their exaltation signs are placed in the 9th (fortune), 10th (career), or 1st (self) houses and are aspected by the lord of the Ascendant, the native will experience "suffering at the end of the vehicle." This means the person may suffer an accident or fall from a vehicle toward the end of a journey or in the later stages of life. Similarly, in the *Sarvartha Chintamani*:

> "If benefic planets are in their exaltation in the 10th, 9th, or 1st houses, and are seen by the lord of the Ascendant, one suffers at the end of the vehicle." || 113-114 ||

If the 4th lord is in an enemy or debilitated sign and is in a "bad" house while being aspected by the 9th lord, one gets a bad vehicle or an unstable one. || 113 ||

If exalted benefic planets located in the 9th, 10th, or 1st houses are aspected by the lord of the Ascendant, one experiences sorrow at the end of a journey. || 114 ||

# Chapter on the Fruits of the Third and Fourth Houses || 12 ||

If Jupiter or the Lord of the Fourth House <note>The Fourth House represents the home, happiness, and vehicles.</note> is joined with a benefic planet in the ninth house from the Ascendant, and is in a gentle sign, the person possesses "human-carried vehicles" <note>original: "naravāhanam"; referring to palanquins or litters carried by men, a sign of high status</note> for a long time and is endowed with royal glory. If these are in a bad house, joined with malefic planets, combust, in debilitation, or in an enemy's sign, there is no fortune of vehicles. If the planet is in its own sign and possesses full strength, the person enjoys long-lasting happiness and rides in a swinging litter <note>original: "āndolikā"; a palanquin or swing-cot</note>. || 115 ||

If the Lords of the Fourth and Tenth Houses are in the eleventh house <note>The house of gains</note> and are strong, they bestow all kinds of good fortune. || 116 ||

If the Lords of the Fourth and Ninth Houses are in the eleventh house or <gloss>4</gloss> aspect the fourth house, the person will be rich in armies and all fortunes, and will be a favorite of the King. || 117 ||

If the Lord of the Ninth <note>The house of dharma/fortune</note> and the Lord of the Fourth are related to the Ascendant and are aspected by Jupiter, the person receives honors and ornaments from the King. || 118 ||

If the Lord of the Ninth and the Lord of the Fourth are joined with benefic planets and are strong, the person becomes the commander of a large army and is wealthy. || 119 ||

If the Lord of the Fourth is in the ninth house with Venus and Jupiter in a benefic sign, or if the Lord of the Ninth is in a quadrant or a trine <note>term: Kendra/Trikona; the most powerful houses in a birth chart</note>, the person acquires many lands, ornaments, wealth, and vehicles. || 120 ||

If the Lords of the <gloss>7</gloss> Seventh, <gloss>6</gloss> Sixth, <gloss>4</gloss> Fourth, <gloss>3</gloss> Third, <gloss>9</gloss> Ninth, <gloss>L</gloss> Ascendant, and <gloss>12</gloss> Twelfth houses are joined with the Lord of the Fourth, the person rules over countless lands. || 121 ||

If the Lord of the Fourth is Jupiter or Venus and is strong in the ninth house from the Ascendant, and the Lord of the Ninth is in a trine or quadrant, the person attains many vehicles. || 122 ||

If the Lord of the Fourth is with Venus and Jupiter in the ninth house, and the Lord of the Ninth is in the fourth house, or if they are in quadrants or trines, the person rules over many lands and possesses many vehicles. || 123 ||

->These nine verses are clear in their meaning, therefore they have not been further commented upon. || 115-123 ||<-

---

If Jupiter or the Lord of the Fourth, joined with a benefic planet, is in the ninth house from the Ascendant and in a gentle sign, then for a very long time, the person attains a human-carried vehicle endowed with royal glory. If Jupiter or the Lord of the Fourth is in a wicked house, joined with a malefic planet, combust, debilitated, or in an enemy's house, then there is no fortune of a vehicle etc. If it is in its own house and is exceedingly strong, then for a long time, one resides in the happiness of a palanquin. || 115 ||

If the Lord of the Fourth and the Lord of the Tenth become strong and are in the house of gains (11th) or aspect the house of gains, they are the givers of all fortune. || 116 ||

If the Lord of the Fourth and the Lord of the Ninth are in the house of gains or aspect the fourth house, the person is endowed with an army and all fortune, and makes the King happy. || 117 ||

If the Lord of the Ninth and the Lord of the Fourth are related to the Ascendant and Jupiter aspects them, the person attains honor and ornaments from the King. || 118 ||

If the Lord of the Ninth and the Lord of the Fourth (Lord of Vehicles) are strong and joined with benefic planets, the person becomes the master of a large army and is wealthy. || 119 ||

If the Lord of the Fourth is attained in the ninth house, is with Venus and Jupiter, and that is a sign of a benefic planet, or if the Lord of the Ninth is in a trine or quadrant, then he attains many lands, ornaments, vehicles, and wealth. || 120 ||

If the Lords of the Seventh, Sixth, Fourth, Third, Ninth, Ascendant, and Twelfth (1-3-4-6-7-9-12) are with the Lord of the Fourth, the person attains countless lands. || 121 ||

If the Lord of the Fourth—Jupiter or Venus—becomes strong and is attained in the ninth house from the Ascendant, and the Lord of the Ninth is in a trine or quadrant, the person is endowed with many vehicles. || 122 ||

If the lord of the 4th house <note>The house of comforts and vehicles</note> is in the 9th house <note>The house of fortune</note> along with Venus and Jupiter, and the lord of the 9th is in the 4th or in a Quadrant or Trine, the person will possess many vehicles and much land. || 123 ||

### Now, the Royal Combinations (Raja Yogas):

->If a benefic planet is in a Quadrant from the Ascendant, a planet in its sign of exaltation is in the 9th,<-
->and the lord of the 2nd house is in a Quadrant, this combination bestows a Throne. || 124 ||<-
->If the 9th house is aspected by benefics, the lord of the 2nd is in a Quadrant with benefics,<-
->and an exalted planet is in the 2nd house, the birth bestows a Throne. || 125 ||<-
->If the lords of the Ascendant, the 4th, and the 9th are in the 10th, and the lord of the 10th is in the Ascendant,<-
->or if that planet aspects the Ascendant, it bestows the result of a Throne. || 126 ||<-
->If the lords of the 10th, the Ascendant, and the 4th have gone to the 10th house,<-
->and the lord of the 10th is related to the Ascendant, one becomes a Lord of the Throne. || 127 ||<-
->If Jupiter, Venus, and the lord of the 9th are in Quadrants or Trines,<-
->one will possess many vehicles and become the ruler of a province. || 128 ||<-
->If the lord of the 4th and the planet in the 10th are strong and aspected by or joined with the lord of the 9th,<-
->or if they have exchanged signs, they bring about the attainment of a Throne. || 129 ||<-
->During the major or minor periods of those planets, or during the transit of those signs,<-
->or when the sub-period of their lords arrives, one becomes a Lord of the Throne. || 130 ||<-

Now, through these seven verses, the combinations that bestow a Throne <term>Simhasana: literally 'lion-seat', meaning a royal throne or high political office</term> are explained.

1. When a benefic planet is in a Quadrant from the Ascendant, a planet is exalted in the 9th, and the lord of the 2nd is in a Quadrant, it is a Throne-bestowing combination. || 124 ||

2. When the 9th house is aspected by a benefic, the lord of the 2nd is in a Quadrant with benefics, and an exalted planet is in the 2nd house, it is a Throne-bestowing combination. || 125 ||

3. If the lords of the Ascendant, 4th, and 9th houses are placed in the 10th house <note>The house of profession and status</note>, and the lord of the 10th is in the Ascendant or aspects the Ascendant, it is a Throne-bestowing combination. || 126 ||

4. If the three lords—of the 10th, Ascendant, and 4th—are all in the 10th house, and the lord of the 10th is connected to the Ascendant, it is a Throne-bestowing combination. || 127 ||

5. If Jupiter, Venus, and the lord of the 9th are in Quadrants or Trines (the 1st, 4th, 7th, 10th, 5th, or 9th houses), then the combination makes one a ruler of a province <term>Mandaleshvara: a regional governor or king</term> endowed with many vehicles. || 128 ||

6. If the lord of the 4th and the planet situated in the 10th house are both strong and are either aspected by or joined with the lord of the 9th, or if they have exchanged signs <note>e.g., the lord of the 4th is in the house of the planet in the 10th, and vice versa</note>, then the combination bestows a Throne. || 129 ||

A person born under the aforementioned combinations becomes a "Lord of the Throne" (seated upon a royal seat). To explain *when* this happens, the text says "During the major or minor periods..." etc. The meaning is that the results should be predicted during the major or minor planetary periods <term>Dasha/Antardasha: time cycles in Vedic astrology</term> of whichever planet acts as the "significator" for the yoga. || 130 ||

If a benefic is in the Ascendant-Quadrant, an exalted planet is in the place of Fortune (9th), and the lord of the 2nd is in a Quadrant, it is a Throne-bestowing combination. That is, a man born in this combination shall sit upon a throne (become a King). || 124 ||

If the 9th is aspected by a benefic, the lord of the 2nd is in a Quadrant with a benefic, and the birth occurs with an exalted planet in the 2nd house, this combination bestows a Throne. || 125 ||

If the lords of the Ascendant, 4th, and 9th are in the 10th (House of Action), and the lord of the 10th is in the Ascendant or aspects the Ascendant, it bestows a Throne. || 126 ||

### Now, the Inquiry into Fortune

> If the Lords of the Ninth and the Ascendant are placed in the House of Happiness <note>the 4th house</note>, and the Lord of the Fourth is in the Ascendant in a benefic sign, the native attains extreme happiness daily; however, if joined with the Lord of the Sixth, one experiences the fortune of an enemy. || 131 ||

(Always) attains. If in the previously mentioned yoga the Lord of the Fourth House is in the house of the enemy (the 6th house), then the individual experiences the fortune of the enemy, meaning they obtain the enjoyment of the rival. The implication is that at that time, their fortune and assets fall into the hands of the enemy. || 131 ||

If the Lord of the Ninth and the Lord of the Ascendant are in the Fourth house, and the Lord of the Fourth is in the Ascendant in a beneficial sign, there is constant and extreme happiness. If the Lord of the Fourth is in the house of the enemy, the enemy obtains the person's fortune. || 131 ||

> If the Lord of the Sixth House is situated in the <term>House of Penance</term> <note>The 9th house, governing fortune and religion</note>, and is aspected by benefics or is endowed with strength, the person gives their own fortune and assets to the enemy for a short time during the period of the <term>Lord of Happiness</term> <note>The Lord of the 4th house</note>. || 132 ||

When the Lord of the Sixth House (the enemy's house) is in the Ninth House, aspected by benefics or strong, then for a short time—a brief period—one gives their own fortune to the enemy and becomes personally deprived of fortune. # Now, the Consideration of Lands.

> If the house of lands contains a beneficial sign, and its lord is joined with a benefic, and the significator of that house is similarly well-placed, the person will possess much land and wealth. || 134 ||
> If the Lord of Lands is in its sign of debilitation or in an enemy's division, or in the sixty-fourth divisions known as <term>Kalagni</term> <note>Time-Fire</note>, <term>Shula</term> <note>The Spear</note>, or <term>Antaka</term> <note>The Ender/Death</note>, or is joined with or aspected by malefics, the wise predict the destruction of lands and property. || 135 ||

Now the <term>Consideration of Lands</term> <note>Kshetras</note> is explained in these two verses. The meaning of the verses is clear. || 134-135 ||

If there is a beneficial sign in the 4th house, the Lord of the Fourth is joined with a benefic, and its significator is in a beneficial place, the native possesses much land and wealth. || 134 ||

If the Lord of the Fourth is in a debilitated sign or an enemy's division, or in the <term>Kalagni</term>, <term>Shula</term>, or <term>Antaka</term> divisions, or is joined with or seen by malefic planets, the experts say there is destruction of land and property. || 135 ||

> If the lord of the house of the Lord of the Ascendant is an enemy planet, during the period or sub-period of that planet, there is destruction of the house and land. During the sub-period of the <term>Lord of Vehicles</term> <note>The 4th Lord</note>, there is loss of one's own kinsmen. A sub-period joined by Saturn, Mars, or Mandi is a cause of calamity. || 136 ||

The "Lord of the House" refers to the Lord of the Fourth. If he is an enemy planet to the Lord of the Ascendant, then during the period or sub-period of that enemy planet, one should know there will be destruction of house and land. During the sub-period of the <term>Lord of Vehicles</term> (the 4th Lord), loss of kinsmen occurs. If this Lord of Vehicles is joined with Saturn, Mars, or Mandi (Gulika), then that sub-period is a cause of calamity—it brings about undesirable results. || 136 ||

If an enemy of the Lord of the Ascendant is in the fourth, then in its period or sub-period, the house and land are destroyed. In the sub-period of the Lord of the Fourth, there is loss of one's family. A sub-period of a planet joined with Saturn, Mars, or Gulika is a cause of calamity (death). || 136 ||

> If the Lord of Wealth and the Lord of Happiness are in the ninth house, joined with benefics in a beneficial sign, one attains <term>Hidden Treasure</term>. If the Lords of Gain and the Forest are in the Fourth House, and their lord is in a beneficial sign joined with benefics, the achievement of hidden treasure occurs. If the Lord of Gain is in the Fourth House joined with benefics, it bestows wealth from hidden treasure. || 137 ||

Now the yogas for attaining <term>Hidden Treasure</term> <note>Nikshepa</note> are described.

# Chapter 12: Results of the Third and Fourth Houses

<page-num>363</page-num>

1. If the Lord of Wealth <note>the 2nd house ruler</note> is joined with the Lord of Happiness <note>the 4th house ruler</note> and is situated in the ninth house, and is further placed in a benefic sign or associated with a benefic planet, the native shall obtain a "deposit" <note>original: *nikṣepaṃ*; refers to hidden or buried treasure</note> from the earth.

2. If the Lords of Gains and Wealth <note>the 11th and 2nd house rulers</note> are situated in the "Underworld" sign <note>the 4th house</note>, and the Lord of that house <note>the 4th ruler</note> is associated with a benefic planet and placed in a favorable sign, then the attainment of hidden wealth <note>original: *nikṣepa-siddhiḥ*</note> is indicated.

3. If the Lord of Gains <note>the 11th house ruler</note> is associated with a benefic planet and occupies the House of Happiness <note>the 4th house</note>, he bestows wealth found in the earth. In these three yogas <note>astrological combinations</note>, the native gains wealth that has been stored underground. || 137 ||

<gloss>If the Lord of Wealth is with the Lord of Happiness in the 9th house in a benefic sign, buried property is obtained. If the 11th and 2nd lords are in the 4th and the 4th lord is well-placed, one finds hidden treasure.</gloss>

### On the Consideration of Houses (Property)

If the Lords of Wealth, Expenditure, and the House <note>2nd, 12th, and 4th rulers</note> are in houses of destruction <note>6th, 8th, or 12th</note> and joined with malefic planets, the native’s house will be dilapidated or sluggish in its comforts, depending on the strength of the malefics. || 138 ||

If a malefic planet or an enemy is in the 4th house, or if the 4th house is aspected by a malefic, the native suffers distress regarding domestic happiness. If Mars or the Sun are in the 4th house in an enemy's sign or a sign of debilitation, the person may be homeless. || 139 ||

If the Lord of the House is debilitated or combust <note>too close to the sun</note>, the native falls into an ocean of sorrow. A malefic in the 4th house brings sin; Saturn in the 4th house causes the destruction of happiness. || 140 ||

If the Lord of the House is in the 12th house from the Ascendant, the native lives in another's house or in a foreign land. In the 8th house, there is a lack of housing; in the 6th, one lives with kinsmen. || 141 ||

If the 4th Lord is strong and well-placed, one gains a palace without effort. If he is in a bad house <note>6th, 8th, or 12th</note> and joined with evil strength, the house is neglected or afflicted by planetary spirits. || 142 ||

The Lords of Expenditure, Wealth, and the House, if placed in the 6th, 3rd, 12th, or 8th houses and joined with malefics, cause the destruction of the home. || 143 ||

A wise person should predict the number and quality of houses based on the strength of planets situated in the Ascendant, the Trines <note>1st, 5th, 9th</note>, and the Quadrants <note>1st, 4th, 7th, 10th</note>. || 144 ||

If the 4th Lord is in the 12th house from the Ascendant, one obtains an old or dilapidated house. If he is strong in a Trine or Quadrant, they say the native will have a wonderful and beautiful house. || 145 ||

If the 4th Lord is in the 3rd house with a benefic and is endowed with strength, or is in the *Gopura* division <note><term>Gopura-amsha</term>: A specific high-quality strength in the Varga system</note>, the native attains a sturdy mansion. || 146 ||

If the Lord of the 10th <note>the King/Authority</note> is in the 4th house with a malefic, or in a cruel division, or in the 8th house division, or joined with the 8th Lord, it is said to cause the destruction of one's commands, actions, and lands. || 147 ||

If the 4th Lord is in the 3rd with a benefic and the Lord of the Ascendant is fully strong, the native possesses a palace <note>original: *harmya*</note> surrounded by walls. || 148 ||

If the Lord of the House is in the *Paravata* division <note><term>Paravata-amsha</term>: A very high level of planetary dignity</note> and aspected by Jupiter and the Moon, or in the *Gopura* division, one should predict a divine or magnificent house. || 149 ||

->Thus, by the grace of the Nine Planets, in the *Jataka Parijata* composed by Vaidyanatha,<-
->ends the Twelfth Chapter. || 12 ||<-

# With the Commentary on Jataka Parijata—

Now, the analysis of the home is discussed in the twelve verses beginning with "The lords of the houses of wealth and expenditure..." These verses are not explained in detail here as their meanings are easily understood. <note>Verses 138–149</note>

->The *Sudha* commentary on the *Parijata* was composed by Kapileshwara.<-
->In this 12th chapter, the results of the Houses are thus completed.<-

If the lords of the second, twelfth, and fourth houses are joined with malefic planets and situated in the eighth house, the person will have as many houses prone to ruin or neglect as there are malefic planets involved. **[138]**

If a malefic planet is in the house of enemies <note>the 6th house</note> or if a malefic aspects the house of happiness <note>the 4th house</note>, the native will suffer sorrows regarding their home. If Mars or the Sun are in their sign of debilitation or an enemy's sign while occupying the 4th house, the person will be without a home. **[139]**

If the planet in the 4th house is in its sign of debilitation or is combust <note>too close to the Sun</note>, the person may fall into a well or a pond. If a malefic is in the 4th house, they will share in sin. If Saturn is in the 4th, happiness is destroyed. **[140]**

If the lord of the 4th house is in the 12th house, the person lives in others' houses or in foreign lands. If in the 8th house, there is a total lack of housing. If in the 6th, they may gather their kin together. **[141]**

If the lord of the 4th house is strong, one gains a home without effort. If the lord of the 4th is weak and in a "bad" house <note>6th, 8th, or 12th</note>, the home is said to be neglected or troubled. **[142]**

As many malefic planets as are joined with the lords of the 12th, 2nd, and 4th houses in the 6th, 3rd, 12th, or 8th houses, that many houses will be destroyed. **[143]**

Wise men say that as many strong planets as there are in the Ascendant, the Trines, or the Quadrants, that many good houses the person will possess. **[144]**

If the lord of the 4th is in the 12th from the Ascendant, the native receives an old house. If the lord of the 4th is strong and in a Trine or Quadrant, the house is said to be beautiful and extraordinary. **[145]**

If a benefic planet is in the 3rd house and the lord of the 4th is strong or in a high dignity like <term>Gopura-amsha</term> <note>a specific strength in divisional charts</note>, the native will possess a sturdy, firm house. **[146]**

If the lord of the 10th house is in the 4th with a malefic, one's authority and land are destroyed. If the lord of the 10th is in a cruel division or a deadly <term>Shashty-amsha</term> <note>1/60th division of a sign</note> and joined with the lord of the 8th, the same result occurs. **[147]**

If the 3rd house is joined with a benefic, the lord of the 4th is powerful, and the lord of the Ascendant is fully strong, the person will have a mansion <note>palatial house</note> surrounded by an enclosure wall. **[148]**

If the lord of the 4th is in its <term>Paravata-amsha</term> <note>a very high dignity</note> and is aspected by Jupiter and the Moon, or is in <term>Gopura-amsha</term>, the house will be like a temple. **[149]**

->Thus ends the "Vimala" Hindi commentary on the twelfth chapter regarding the results of the Houses in the Jataka Parijata.<-

## Chapter 13: On the Results of the Fifth and Sixth Houses

### Results of the Fifth House

> One should consider the <term>Deva</term> (Deity), <term>Mahiputra</term> (Kingship/Land), <term>Pitri</term> (Father), <term>Dhi</term> (Intelligence), and <term>Punya</term> (Merit) from the Fifth House.
> Travel is seen from the 7th, 5th, and 10th houses, and distant wandering from the 12th.
> Happiness from the father is seen from the Ascendant and the Sun; children from the position of Jupiter;
> And wealth and prosperity from the 7th house, the lord of wealth, and Venus. **[1]**

Now, wishing to explain the results of the 5th house, the author first describes the method of considering various matters: From the "Son" <note>the 5th house</note>, one should consider: <term>Deva</term> = the deity one worships; <term>Mahipa</term> = royal yogas or status; <term>Putra</term> = children and father; <term>Dhi</term> = intellect; <term>Punyam</term> = good deeds. One should consider journeys from the second and tenth houses. From the twelfth house <note>original: "riṣphataḥ"</note>, one should contemplate travel to distant lands or foreign countries. From the Ascendant <term>Lagna|The rising sign or first house of the zodiac</term> and the lord of the fourth house, and from the Sun, one should consider the happiness or welfare of the father. From the position of Jupiter and the fifth house, the attainment of a son should be contemplated. From the seventh house, the lord of the second house, and Venus <note>original: "anaṅga-vitta-pasitaiḥ"</note>, one should consider the wealth of the wife. When the respective significators <term>Karaka|A planet that acts as a 'significator' for a specific area of life</term> and the houses themselves are marked by auspicious characteristics, good results are predicted; otherwise, the opposite should be stated. || 1 ||

From the fifth house, one considers deities, kings, sons, the father, intellect, and merit <note>original: "punya"</note>. From the seventh, fifth, second, and tenth houses, one considers journeys. From the twelfth, consider long-distance travel. From the Ascendant, the fourth house, and the Sun, consider the father. From Jupiter and the fifth house, consider the attainment of a son. From the lord of the seventh, the lord of the second, and Venus, consider the wealth of the wife. || 1 ||

->### Now, the Consideration of Deities.<-

> If the fifth house from the Ascendant is occupied or aspected by a male planet, the person worships a male deity.
> If it is a feminine sign occupied or aspected by Venus or the Moon, he desires a female deity.
> If the Sun is there, the Sun is the chief; if the Moon and Venus are joined, Gauri; if Mars, Kumara;
> If the son of the Moon (Mercury), Vishnu; if Jupiter, the Bearer of the Moon (Shiva); if Saturn and others are joined, other deities. || 2 ||

Now he speaks of the deity to be worshipped by the native—"From the Ascendant," etc. If the "soul" (the fifth house) from the Ascendant is aspected or joined by a male planet—any of the Sun, Mars, or Jupiter—one should say the native worships a male deity. A person born under this yoga <term>Yoga|A specific planetary combination or alignment</term> becomes a devotee of a male god. If that fifth house is in an even sign <note>original: "yugme"</note> and is aspected or joined by Venus or the Moon, the native desires a female deity. This is because even signs, Venus, and the Moon are feminine in nature. If the Sun is joined or aspects the fifth house, the Sun or other male deities are to be named. For the Moon and Venus, one should name the goddess Gauri. For Mars, Kumara (Kartikeya); for the son of the Moon (Mercury), Vishnu; for Jupiter, the Bearer of the Moon (Shiva); and for the conjunction of Saturn and others, one should name other "lesser" or "minor" deities. || 2 ||

If a male planet aspects or is situated in the fifth house from the Ascendant, the native should worship a male deity. If the fifth house is an even sign and Venus or the Moon is in the fifth or aspects that place, the teachers have said the worship of a female deity is indicated. If the Sun is in the fifth house, worship the Sun; if the Moon and Venus, Gauri; if Mars, Kartikeya; if Mercury, Vishnu; if Jupiter, Shankar (Shiva); if there is a combination of Saturn, Rahu, or Ketu in the fifth, worship other (lesser) deities. || 2 ||

> If the lord of the fifth house is an enemy to the lord of the Ascendant, devotion to that deity causes the loss of a son.
> If they are neutral, the result is mediocre; if they are friends, the native receives the boundless grace of that deity. || 3 ||

Now he speaks of the result of worshipping the deity based on the relationship between the planets—"The lord of the Ascendant," etc. If the lord of the fifth house <note>original: "ātmapatau"</note> is an enemy <note>original: "sapatne"</note> to the lord of the Ascendant, devotion to that deity becomes the cause of the loss of the native's son. If the lord of the fifth is neutral <note>original: "sāmyatare"</note> toward the lord of the Ascendant, the devotion to that deity is mediocre—neither good nor bad. If the lord of the fifth is a friend to the lord of the Ascendant, the native attains the "boundless grace" or supreme favor of that deity; in that case, the worship of that deity becomes extremely beneficial. || 3 ||

If the lord of the fifth is an enemy of the lord of the Ascendant, then devotion to that deity may cause the loss of a son. If they are neutral, the result remains average. If the lord of the fifth is a friend of the lord of the Ascendant, then through the worship of that deity, one's work reaches completion. || 3 ||

->### Now, the Consideration of Royalty.<-

> If the house of royalty (the 10th or 5th) is aspected or joined by Jupiter, Mercury, or Venus,
> and the lord of that sign is strong, the native attains the favor and wealth of the King.

If the lord of the fifth house is occupied by a malefic, lacks strength, and is in a cruel division <note>original: "krura-bhaga," referring to a specific harmful subdivision of a zodiac sign</note>, the person born is devoid of learning, humility, virtue, intelligence, and royal honor. || 4 ||

If the fifth house is aspected by <note>aspected: in astrology, when one planet "looks at" or influences another from a specific distance</note> Mercury, Jupiter, and Venus, or is in conjunction with them, and its lord is strong, one receives wealth through the king's pleasure. If the lord of the fifth house is occupied by a malefic, is without strength, and is in a cruel division, the native <note>the person whose birth chart is being read</note> is devoid of learning, humility, virtue, intelligence, and royal honor.

### Now, the Inquiry into Births

**If the lord of the house of vehicles <note>the 4th house</note> is in the ascendant <note>the 1st house</note>, and the lord of the body <note>the 1st house lord</note> is in the house of happiness <note>the 4th house</note>, and they are aspected by or conjoined with other planets, it signifies the birth of a quadruped. If with Rahu or Ketu <note>the North and South Nodes of the Moon</note>, a goat is born. With Jupiter, Venus, or the Moon, a cow is born. If aspected by or conjoined with Saturn, a buffalo is born. If the lord of the body is in the tenth house and the King of Serpents <note>Rahu</note> is in the ascendant, the birth occurs feet-first.** || 5 ||

Now he describes the knowledge of the birth of certain quadrupeds: "In the ascendant," etc. If the lord of the fourth house is in the first house, and the lord of the first house is in the fourth, and they are aspected by or conjoined with other planets as possible, one should understand it as the birth of a quadruped (an animal). He then gives details: with Rahu or Ketu, a goat is born. If aspected by any of Jupiter, Venus, or the Moon, the birth of a cow should be declared. If aspected by or conjoined with Saturn, a buffalo is born. Furthermore, if the lord of the first house is in the tenth house and Rahu is situated in the ascendant, the birth is "feet-first." In this yoga <note>astrological combination</note>, the feet of the newborn appear first, then the head. || 5 ||

If the lord of the fourth house is in the first, the lord of the first is in the fourth, and they are joined or seen by planets, know it as an animal birth. Among those, by Rahu-Ketu know a goat. By Jupiter, Venus, and the Moon, know the birth of a cow. If seen by or joined with Saturn, say it is the birth of a buffalo. If the lord of the first is in the tenth and Rahu is in the first, the native is born feet-first. || 5 ||

**If the lords of the fifth and fourth houses are in the second and seventh houses, and are aspected by or conjoined with malefics, and if a male planet is in a male division, then monkeys, boars, cats, and the like are born.** || 6 ||

Now he describes the birth of monkeys, boars, cats, etc.: "In the second and seventh," etc. If the lords of the fifth and fourth houses are in the second and seventh houses respectively, and are aspected by or joined with malefic planets, and if a male planet (Sun, Mars, or Jupiter) has gone into a male decanate <note>a 10-degree subdivision of a sign</note>, then monkeys, boars, cats, and the like are born. The meaning is that in this combination, the birth of monkeys, pigs, cats, etc., occurs. || 6 ||

If the lords of the fifth and fourth are in the second and seventh, and are seen by or joined with malefic planets, and a male planet is in a male decanate, know the native to be a monkey, boar, cat, etc. || 6 ||

**In that same combination, if aspected by Saturn and Mercury, the birth is a lump-like form. If Jupiter is with Rahu and aspected by a weak planet, one born in a priestly lineage performs lowly acts. If Jupiter, Rahu, and Saturn are in one place and aspected by Venus and Mercury, even a laborer attains equality with the twice-born <note>the upper castes</note> and a priest attains all knowledge.** || 7 ||

"In that," etc. In the previously mentioned combination (a male planet in a male division), if aspected by Saturn and Mercury, the birth is "lump-shaped." In this combination, whatever is born is devoid of limbs and distinct parts. If Jupiter is with Rahu and aspected by a strengthless planet, then one born in the lineage of the gods-of-the-earth (the Brahmins) becomes a performer of base deeds. In this combination, even one born in a Brahmin family acts like a low-born person. If Jupiter, Rahu, and Saturn are in one place...

# Chapter 13: Results of the Fifth and Sixth Houses

...if they are aspected <note>aspected: in astrology, this refers to a planet 'looking at' or influencing another based on its position</note> by Mercury and Saturn, then even one born as a Shudra <note>Shudra: the fourth social class in traditional Indian society</note> attains the status of a Twice-born <note>Twice-born: 'Dvija', referring to the upper three social classes, particularly Brahmins</note>; he becomes equal to a Brahmin. In this planetary combination, even one of Shudra birth acts like a Brahmin. The meaning is that he performs high-status deeds. If one born in this combination is already a Brahmin by lineage, then he attains all knowledge, meaning he becomes a scholar of all sciences.

If Saturn and Mercury aspect the previously mentioned lords of the fifth and fourth houses, the birth is like a lump of flesh <note>original: 'pinda'; likely referring to a lack of physical development or a stillbirth</note>. If Jupiter is aspected by a weak planet along with Rahu <note>Rahu: the North Node of the Moon, considered a shadow planet</note>, then even a Brahmin is born as one who performs lowly deeds. If Jupiter, Rahu, and Saturn are in one place and are aspected by Venus and Mercury, then even a Shudra attains equality with a Brahmin, and a Brahmin attains all knowledge.

## Now, the Consideration of Children.

> If the houses of children and spouse from the Ascendant <note>Ascendant: 'Lagna', the zodiac sign rising on the eastern horizon at birth</note> or from the Moon are occupied or aspected by beneficial planets or their own lords, then there is prosperity for both; otherwise, it is impossible. If the Sun is in Virgo at the Ascendant and Saturn is in Pisces, it destroys the wife. If Mars is in the house of children, it gives the death of the son. || 8 ||

Now he describes the knowledge of the presence or absence of a wife and children—"From the Ascendant" etc. If from the birth Ascendant, in the fifth house (children) and the seventh house (spouse), there is a connection with a beneficial planet and the lord of that house, or if they are aspected by them; or if from the Moon at the time of birth, the fifth and seventh houses are joined or aspected by beneficial planets and their respective lords, then there is certainly prosperity for children and the wife. 

Specifically, if the fifth house from the Ascendant or the Moon is joined or aspected by a beneficial planet and the lord of the fifth house, the attainment of a son occurs. Similarly, if the seventh house from the Ascendant or the Moon is joined or aspected by a beneficial planet and the lord of the seventh house, there is prosperity regarding a wife. Otherwise, it is impossible. For whomsoever the fifth house from the Ascendant or the Moon is not aspected by or joined with a benefit or its lord, there is no birth of a son. Such a person would be childless. Similarly, if the seventh house from the Ascendant or the Moon is not joined or aspected by a beneficial planet and its lord, then he will have no wife. Here, "houses of children and spouse" is just an illustration; in fact, all houses should be judged by this same logic.

> "Whichever house is aspected by or joined with its own lord or by beneficial planets, that house prospers."

This is because of the specific traditional teaching. Regarding "Sun in Virgo" etc.: if the Sun is in the Virgo Ascendant and Saturn is situated in Pisces, the person born becomes a "wife-destroyer," meaning one whose wife has died. In this same combination (Sun in Virgo Ascendant), if the son of the Earth—Mars—is in the house of children (the fifth house, which would be Capricorn), then it gives the death of the son. The meaning is that the son of one born in this combination dies. || 8 ||

If there is a connection or aspect of beneficial planets or their lords in the fifth and seventh houses from the Ascendant or the Moon, then the happiness of children and wife will be good. Otherwise, their attainment is impossible. If the Sun is in Virgo at the Ascendant and Saturn is in Pisces, there is loss of the wife. If Mars is in the house of children, there is the death of the son. || 8 ||

<lang>English translation from Sanskrit and Hindi</lang>
<vocab>Lord of the 5th, House of Children, Benefic Planet, Rahu, Angles and Trines, Sixfold Division, Adopted Son, Vaisheshika Division</vocab>

...takes. Here, this should be considered: between the planet situated in the fifth house and the <term>significator</term> <note>Karaka, specifically Jupiter for children</note> of that house, whichever is stronger—look at the <term>sixfold division</term> <note>Shadvarga: a system of six divisional charts used to determine planetary strength</note> of that planet's house. Whichever division remains empty of planets, the caste or class associated with that house determines the class from which the person will adopt a son.

If the Lord of the Ascendant and the Lord of the 5th are in <term>evil houses</term> <note>Dusthanas: the 6th, 8th, or 12th houses</note> but are aspected by benefic planets, they grant an adopted son. Between the planet in the 5th house and the significator, whichever is stronger, one should adopt from the class corresponding to the empty space in their sixfold division. || 13 ||

->If the Lord of the 5th is in a benefic sign, situated in an angle or a trine, and joined with a benefic, one obtains a son in youth.<-
->A son born during the period of the Lord of the 5th when joined with the Lord of Serpents <note>Rahu</note> is short-lived; one born during the period of the Serpent <note>Rahu</note> itself is long-lived.<- || 14 ||

**Regarding "Kendra...":** The Lord of the 5th house, being in a benefic sign and placed in an <term>angle or trine</term> <note>The 1st, 4th, 7th, 10th, 5th, or 9th houses</note>, if joined with a benefic planet, then in youth (at an early age), one obtains a son. Now, he describes the yogas <note>astrological combinations</note> for the short or long life of the son: "Joined with the Lord of Serpents..." A son born during the <term>sub-period</term> <note>Bhukti</note> of the Lord of the 5th house when that Lord is joined with the Lord of Serpents (Rahu) is short-lived. A son born during the sub-period of the Serpent (Rahu) itself <insert>when Rahu is joined with the Lord of the 5th</insert> attains a long life. || 14 ||

If the Lord of the 5th in a benefic sign is in an angle or trine and joined by a benefic, a son is obtained in youth. If born in the sub-period of the 5th Lord joined with Rahu, he is short-lived; if in the Rahu sub-period, he attains long life. || 14 ||

->If the Lord of the 5th and the Lord of the 2nd are devoid of strength, and the 5th house is aspected by malefic planets,<-
->the person, even if possessing many wives, will certainly experience a lack of children.<-
->If his wife is born with a yoga for children, and the 5th house is aspected by a benefic or by the 6th from the 5th,<-
->she becomes a mother of a son through a paramour.<- || 15 ||

**Now** he describes the yoga for lack of children and the yoga for a son by a paramour: "The Lord of the 5th and the Lord of the 2nd..." If the Lord of the 5th and the Lord of the 2nd are both weak, and the 5th house is aspected by malefics, the man, even with many wives, will certainly remain childless. This means that even if such a man marries many times, no son is born to any of his wives. However, if his wife possesses a yoga for children, and the 5th house is aspected by a benefic or by the 6th from the 5th (meaning the 10th Lord from the Ascendant), she becomes a mother through another man. In that case, the son is not the biological offspring of the husband, but is a <term>son of the field</term> <note>Kshetraja: a legal son born to a wife by another man under specific traditional customs</note>. || 15 ||

If the Lord of the 5th and the Lord of Wealth <note>2nd Lord</note> are powerless and the house of children is seen by a malefic, the person remains childless despite many wives. If the wife has a child-bearing yoga, and the 5th is seen by a benefic or the 6th-from-the-5th, she has a son by another man. || 15 ||

->When the 5th house, its Lord, or Jupiter is aspected by a benefic,<-
->or joined with a benefic planet, there is no doubt of obtaining a son.<- || 16 ||
->When the Lord of the Ascendant is in the 5th house, the Lord of the 5th is strong,<-
->and Jupiter is in full strength, there is no doubt of obtaining a son.<- || 17 ||
->When Jupiter is in the 5th house with full strength,<-
->and is aspected by the Lord of the Ascendant, there is no doubt of obtaining a son.<- || 18 ||
->When Jupiter is in a <term>Vaisheshika division</term> <note>A high-strength planetary dignity</note> and the Lord of the 5th is similarly placed,<-
->and aspected by a benefic lord, one should predict the attainment of a son.<- || 19 ||

## Chapter 13: On the Results of the Fifth and Sixth Houses

Now, the planetary combinations <term>Yogas; specific alignments of planets that produce particular results</term> that grant sons are described in the four verses starting with "The place of the son..." etc. These verses are quite simple in their meaning. || 16-19 ||

If the Fifth House, or the Lord of the Fifth, or Jupiter <note>Jupiter is the natural significator for children in Vedic astrology</note> is aspected by a benefic planet or joined with a benefic planet, then without a doubt, a son will be obtained. || 16 ||

If the Lord of the Ascendant <term>Lagnēśa; the planet ruling the first house</term> is in the Fifth House, the Lord of the Fifth is strong, and Jupiter is fully powerful, then without a doubt, a son will be obtained. || 17 ||

If a fully powerful Jupiter is in the Fifth House and is aspected by the Lord of the Ascendant, then without a doubt, a son will be obtained. || 18 ||

If Jupiter is in a <term>Vaisheshikansha; a specific high-quality division in the birth chart</term>, and the Lord of the Fifth is similarly placed, and the Lord of the Ninth aspects the Fifth House, then that person will obtain a son. || 19 ||

->If the Moon is in the tenth house, Venus is in the seventh, and malefic planets are in the fourth,<-
->the destruction of his lineage will occur, there is no doubt. || 20 ||<-
->If the Lord of the Ascendant is in the sixth or eighth house, and the Lord of the Son is joined with a malefic,<-
->or is aspected by planets in enemy or debilitated signs, the wise should predict the loss of sons. || 21 ||<-
->If malefic planets are placed in the first, seventh, ninth, and twelfth houses,<-
->and are in the signs or divisions of enemies, they cause the extinction of the lineage. || 22 ||<-

Now, the combinations that cause the extinction of the lineage are described in the three verses starting with "The Moon in the tenth..." etc. These verses are easy to understand, so no further explanation is needed. || 20-22 ||

If the Moon is in the tenth house, Venus is in the seventh, and malefic planets are in the fourth house, then the person's offspring will undoubtedly be destroyed. || 20 ||

If the Lord of the Ascendant is in the sixth or eighth house, and the Lord of the Fifth is joined with a malefic planet or is aspected by a planet in an enemy's house or a debilitated sign, one should predict the loss of sons. || 21 ||

If malefic planets are in the first, seventh, ninth, and twelfth houses, and are in the signs or divisions of enemies, they act as destroyers of the lineage. || 22 ||

->The barren, the aged, the emaciated, the very young, the diseased, the one without menses,<-
->the harsh-natured, and the one with a heavy body—these eight types of women are to be avoided. || 23 ||<-

Now he describes the eight types of women to be avoided—"The barren..." etc. Barren = childless (<gloss>Barren woman</gloss>), aged = of advanced age, emaciated = having a wasted body, young = of very tender age, diseased = afflicted by illness, without menses = lacking menstrual flow, harsh = ill-behaved, and heavy-bodied. These eight types of women are to be avoided. The meaning is that men desiring well-being should not marry women characterized by these eight traits.

Barren, aged, emaciated (thin), very young, diseased, without menses (devoid of cycles), harsh, and heavy-bodied (fat)—these 8 women are forbidden. One should examine these traits before marriage.

->When Jupiter, the Lord of the Ascendant, the Lord of the Seventh, and the Lord of the Fifth,<-
->are all devoid of strength, childlessness should be predicted. || 24 ||<-
->When a malefic is in the Fifth House and its Lord is in a debilitated sign,<-
->and it is devoid of any benefic aspect, childlessness should be predicted. || 25 ||<-
->When malefic planets are in the fifth house from Jupiter, the Ascendant, or the Moon,<-
->and are devoid of benefic aspects or conjunctions, childlessness should be predicted. || 26 ||<-
->When a malefic is in the Fifth House and its Lord is hemmed between malefics,<-
->and is devoid of benefic aspects or conjunctions, childlessness should be predicted. || 27 ||<-
->When Jupiter is hemmed between malefics and the Lord of the Fifth is devoid of strength,<-
->and is devoid of benefic aspects or conjunctions, childlessness should be predicted. || 28 ||<-

# With the Commentary of Jataka Parijata

Now, the combinations for childlessness are explained—**by the following five verses.**

1. If **Jupiter, the Lord of the Ascendant, the Lord of the 7th House, and the Lord of the 5th House** are all devoid of strength, then the **childlessness** (**absence of progeny**) of the native occurs. A person born under this combination becomes one without lineage.

2. When a malefic planet is present in the 5th house, and the Lord of the 5th house is in its sign of debilitation <note>original: "nicangate" - the position where a planet is at its weakest</note>, and it lacks the aspect of any benefic planets, childlessness occurs.

3. If there are malefic planets in the 5th house from Jupiter, from the Ascendant, and from the Moon, and they are devoid of the aspect or conjunction of benefics, then childlessness occurs.

4. If a malefic planet has entered the 5th house, and the Lord of the 5th house is placed between two malefic planets <note>original: "papadwaya-madhyagata" - a condition known as Papa Kartari Yoga, where a house or planet is 'hemmed in' by harmful influences</note>, and is devoid of the aspect or conjunction of benefics, then childlessness occurs.

5. If Jupiter is placed between two malefic planets, and the Lord of the Sons (the Lord of the 5th house) is weak and devoid of benefic aspects or conjunctions, then childlessness occurs. || 24-28 ||

If Jupiter, the Lord of the Ascendant, the Lord of the 7th, and the Lord of the 5th are all powerless, call it childlessness (without progeny). || 24 ||

If a malefic planet is in the place of sons, the Lord of sons is in a debilitated sign, and there is no aspect from a benefic planet, call it childlessness. || 25 ||

If there are malefic planets in the 5th from Jupiter, the Ascendant, and the Moon, and they are not seen by or joined with benefics, call it childlessness. || 26 ||

If a malefic planet is in the place of sons, and the Lord of sons is between malefic planets, and there is no aspect or conjunction of a benefic there, call it childlessness. || 27 ||

If Jupiter is between malefic planets, the Lord of sons is weak, and a benefic does not aspect or join it, call it childlessness. || 28 ||

->If the place of sons is in a sign of Mercury or a sign of Saturn,<-
->And is joined or aspected by Mandi or Saturn, then there are adopted sons and the like. || 29 ||<-

Now the combination for adopted children is stated—"In the place of sons," etc. <term>Sign of Mercury</term> = either Gemini or Virgo; or <term>Sign of Saturn</term> = either Capricorn or Aquarius. If the place of sons (the 5th house) is in these, and it is joined or aspected by Mandi or Saturn = joined or seen by either Gulika <note>A mathematical point in the sky considered a "shadow planet" with a Saturn-like influence</note> or Saturn, or both, then the native has adopted sons and the like. In this combination, the native does not have a biological son, but rather adopted children and others are utilized as sons. As it is said in the *Phaladeepika* <note>A classic 13th-century astrological text by Mantreswara</note>:

> "If the house of sons belongs to Saturn or Mercury, and is joined or aspected by Mandi or the son of the Sun (Saturn), there will be an adopted son, provided the Lord of the 5th is weak and lacks connection with the Lords of the 1st and 7th houses."

If in the house of sons there is a sign of Mercury (3, 6) or a sign of Saturn (10, 11), and Saturn or Gulika is there or aspects it, there may be an adopted son. || 29 ||

->One in Pisces has very few children; in Sagittarius, children with great difficulty.<-
->In Cancer, there is no lineage; Jupiter in Aquarius, no lineage. || 30 ||<-
->In the place of sons, whether in Cancer, Pisces, Aquarius, or Sagittarius,<-
->If the Teacher of the Gods (Jupiter) is situated, he produces such results for men. || 31 ||<-

Now the consideration of progeny based on the position of Jupiter is stated—"One in Pisces," etc. If Jupiter is <term>situated in Pisces</term>, the native will have very few children. If Jupiter is in Sagittarius, then <term>children with difficulty</term> = he will have children only with great effort. In this combination, a son is born to the native through various efforts (such as the worship of deities). If Jupiter is <term>situated in Cancer</term>, then there is no lineage = the native is...

# Chapter 13: Results of the Fifth and Sixth Houses

...there is a lack of offspring. Similarly, if Jupiter is situated in Aquarius, then also no offspring are born. If the Teacher of the Gods = Jupiter is situated in the Fifth House (the house of children) in any one of the four previously mentioned signs—Cancer, Pisces, Aquarius, or Sagittarius—then that Jupiter grants the result of producing offspring for men = those born under this influence. <note>The text notes a specific exception where Jupiter, usually a bringer of children, may struggle in certain signs unless specific conditions are met.</note>

In the house of Pisces, there are few children; in Sagittarius, children are obtained with difficulty; in exalted Jupiter (Cancer), one is childless; and in Aquarius, there may be no children. ॥ 30 ॥

If the Fifth House contains the signs of Cancer, Pisces, Aquarius, or Sagittarius, and Jupiter is situated there, one should predict the result of the birth of children for men. ॥ 31 ॥

> If the house is aspected by a malefic planet, loss of children occurs due to a curse from the gods.
> If it is joined or aspected by the lord of the sixth house, loss of children occurs due to a curse from a Brahmin. ॥ 32 ॥
> If the lord of the fifth house is joined with Mars and aspected by the lord of the sixth,
> and is devoid of any benefic aspect, loss of children occurs due to the faults of enemies. ॥ 33 ॥
> If a malefic is in the ninth house, and the lord of the fifth is joined with Saturn,
> or if Mandi <note>A mathematical point in Vedic astrology considered malefic, also known as Gulika.</note> is in a trine (1st or 5th house), loss of children occurs due to the faults of the father. ॥ 34 ॥
> If a malefic is in the house of the mother (4th house), and the lord of the fifth is joined with Saturn,
> and that malefic lord of the fifth is in the twelfth or eighth house, loss of children occurs due to the faults of the mother. ॥ 35 ॥
> If Rahu or Ketu <note>The North and South Nodes of the Moon, often called the "shadow planets."</note> are joined or aspecting the fifth house while it is weak,
> or if its lord is in such a state, loss of children occurs due to the curse of a serpent. ॥ 36 ॥
> If Jupiter, the lord of the fifth, the lord of the seventh, and Mars are joined together,
> the wise should predict the loss of sons and daughters due to the affliction of an evil deity. ॥ 37 ॥

Now he describes the causes for the loss of offspring—starting with the verse "If by a malefic planet," etc. When the Fifth House, the lord of the Fifth, or Jupiter is aspected by a malefic planet, the loss of children for the native occurs due to a curse from the gods = a fault arising from the disrespect of some deity. In that same context, if it is joined with or aspected by the lord of the sixth house = the ruler of the sixth house, loss of children occurs due to a curse from a Brahmin = through the harsh words of a priest or learned man. ॥ 32 ॥

If the lord of the fifth = the ruler of the fifth house is joined with Mars and aspected by the lord of the sixth = the ruler of the sixth house, and is without the aspect of any benefic planet, loss of children occurs due to the faults of enemies = through the offenses of an adversary. ॥ 33 ॥

If a malefic planet is joined in the ninth house, and the lord of the fifth = the ruler of the fifth house is joined with Saturn, or if Mandi = Gulika is situated in a trine (1st or 5th house), loss of children occurs due to the faults of the father = through the offenses of the father. ॥ 34 ॥

If some malefic is in the house of the mother (4th house), and the malefic lord of the fifth is joined with Saturn—meaning a malefic planet becomes the lord of the fifth and, joined with Saturn, is placed in the twelfth or eighth house—then the loss of children should be declared as being due to the faults of the mother = through the curse of the mother. ॥ 35 ॥
